items.text:
Ostranauts has a steep learning curve, unique delivery of story/character content, and a number of bugs that need to be hashed out. Aside from the tutorial (which has improved significantly since the beginning), it does not hold your hand. It gave me difficulty in my first 5-10 hours, and I lost steam with it for a while. That being said, when I pushed through that and got a handle on the UI, character management, fully explored ship building, and started some questlines it became apparent there's a lot more going on with this game than some people give it credit for.

This game is a slow burn. Usually it respects your time, sometimes it doesn't (went to Titan shipyard to buy a corvette and only junkers were for sale) - you are insignificant and the sandbox world around will just spiral sometimes (random dead stations for example - though I haven't come across this). But when you survive that first trip to another planet, your first micrometorite strike, or get chased down by pirates only to fight them off with a katana and win/take their ship - it nets you that feeling few games seem to nail these days.

It's enjoyable to fix up a floating wreck and make it your own, build out your starter coffin, find that one piece of salvage you were looking for, or take out a giant loan on something luxury. Same for those frantic moments where you have to decide whether or not to vent your cabin because you let a piece of conduit go too long so there's a fire, but you also have a limited amount of nitrogen/oxygen to replenish your atmosphere. It captures the spectrum of hard sci-fi experiences we imagine pretty well; from the monotony of inter-planetary travel and those time of pure panic and uncertainty if you and your crew is going to make it to your destination. In some ways, it's like a version of The Sims where your home is your ship and you could die over a seemingly insignificant oversight -- or a system authority vessel could collide with you at 1 km/s.

If you like the following games or some of their mechanics you may like this one: Project Zomboid, Kenshi, KSP, Hardspace Shipbreaker. If you like The Expanse or other grounded sci-fi you may like this as well. Results not guaranteed, but I like this title. 

If you'd like to see someone who is earnest in their assessment of the game and quirks but clearly still enjoys it, check out Rhadamat's YouTube channel to see how it may fit for you.
items.text_zh:
《Ostranauts》学习曲线陡峭，故事/角色内容的呈现方式独特，还有不少需要解决的bug。除了教程（自最初以来已显著改进）之外，它不会手把手教你。在我最初的5到10个小时里，它让我感到困难，我一度对它失去了热情。话虽如此，当我挺过那段时期，掌握了UI、角色管理，全面探索了飞船建造，并开始了一些任务线之后，就明显能看出这款游戏的内容比一些人认为的要多得多。

这款游戏是慢热型的。通常它会尊重你的时间，有时则不会（去泰坦造船厂想买一艘护卫舰，结果只有破烂货在卖）——你无足轻重，周围的沙盒世界有时就是会失控（比如随机出现的死寂空间站——虽然我还没遇到过）。但当你挺过第一次前往另一个星球的旅程、第一次微陨石撞击，或者被海盗追上来，却只用一把武士刀击退他们并获胜/夺走他们的飞船时——它会带给你如今很少有游戏似乎能抓住的那种感觉。

修好一艘漂浮的残骸并把它变成你自己的、扩建你的初始棺材舱、找到你一直在找的那一件 salvage，或者为某件奢侈品背上一大笔贷款，这些都很有乐趣。那些疯狂的时刻也是如此：你必须决定是否要给船舱泄压，因为你让一段管道拖得太久所以起火了，但你的氮气/氧气储量也有限，需要补充大气。它相当好地捕捉到了我们想象中的硬科幻体验的整个光谱；从行星际旅行的单调乏味，到那种纯粹恐慌和不确定你和你的船员能否抵达目的地的时刻。在某些方面，它就像是一个版本的《模拟人生》，只不过你的家就是你的飞船，你可能会因为一个看似微不足道的疏忽而死掉——或者一艘系统当局的飞船可能以1公里/秒的速度撞上你。

如果你喜欢以下游戏或它们的某些机制，你可能会喜欢这款：Project Zomboid、Kenshi、KSP、Hardspace Shipbreaker。如果你喜欢《苍穹浩瀚》或其他接地气的科幻作品，你也可能会喜欢这款。结果不保证，但我喜欢这款作品。

如果你想看看一个对这款游戏及其怪癖做出真诚评价、但显然仍然很享受它的人，可以去看看Rhadamat的YouTube频道，看看它是否适合你。

items.text:
Ostranauts isn't just a game about taking scrap metal from broken spaceships; it does a great job capturing the tough, everyday struggle of surviving in space. The detailed gameplay, from manually fixing circuit boards and managing your oxygen to slowly paying off a massive debt, gives it a cool retro sci-fi vibe that easily pulls you in.

However, the 1.0 full release feels clearly rushed. Even though it is officially out of Early Access, the game still has noticeable bugs and rough edges that can ruin your immersion during an otherwise great salvage run.

There is a great simulation hidden here if you love detailed survival games and living on the margins of space. But with its current bugs, it’s best to wait for a sale or discount before picking it up.
items.text_zh:
《Ostranauts》不仅仅是一款从破损飞船中回收废金属的游戏；它出色地捕捉了在太空中生存那种艰难、日常的挣扎。从手动修理电路板、管理氧气到慢慢偿还巨额债务，这些细致的玩法赋予了它一种很酷的复古科幻氛围，很容易把你吸引进去。

然而，1.0正式版感觉明显仓促。尽管它已正式脱离抢先体验，游戏仍有明显的bug和粗糙边缘，会在原本很棒的打捞过程中破坏你的沉浸感。

如果你喜欢细节丰富的生存游戏和生活在太空边缘，这里隐藏着一个很棒的模拟。但就目前的bug而言，最好等打折或降价再入手。

Put a lot of hours into the game but it's still a buggy when it's stable and broken when it isn't. 

So many deaths don't feel like I have any control over. Being obliterated by a hauler going mach ♥♥♥♥ while I'm docked on a wreck, an unpressurised "engine room" blowing up due to over pressurisation and the worst I've experienced recently my character refusing to breathe outside of an EVA suit including the starting space station. 

Ship building is also a slog, making a retrofit of expansion such a headache. You can't rely of autotask because it will leave holes or for some reason bounce from one corner of the work area to the other furthest corner and leave holes and gaps everywhere but then doing it manually will take ages

items.text:
I couldn't get myself to give a thumbs down, because despite the state it's in even at 1.0+, I love this game. I want others to love this game. It's unique and has heart, and it scratches a very specific itch. The excitement when docking with a derelict, not knowing if you're about to have a band of pirates marching into your beat up pod like a clown car, or score big and go home with enough gear to build up your ship enough to go out longer and further is real, and it's a lot of fun building your ship to be just the way you want it.

But the unfortunate truth is that it came out undercooked. There's tons of bugs still. Some are just silly things that don't have much consequence (like the starting area seemingly having an endless parade of criminals coming in and starting punchfests with the locals), but others get you killed or lock you out of some content (inexplicable breathing issues, or not being able to do certain repeatable tasks because it was resolved incorrectly). Maybe it will be patched and expanded into what it was meant to be, but for now I can only recommend it with a huge asterisk. You might get a lot of fun out of it, but be ready for a lot of frustration on the side.
items.text_zh:

但不幸的是，它推出时确实欠火候。仍然有大量bug。有些只是没什么后果的蠢事（比如起始区域似乎有无穷无尽的罪犯涌入，和当地人打成一团），但另一些会让你丧命或把你锁在某些内容之外（莫名其妙的呼吸问题，或者因为任务被错误地判定完成而无法进行某些可重复任务）。也许它会被修补并扩展成它本该成为的样子，但就目前而言，我只能带着一个巨大的星号来推荐它。你可能会从中获得很多乐趣，但也要准备好面对随之而来的大量挫败感。

items.text:
I do really enjoy the game and can play it for hours. However, the fact that I have to make sure I save every 5-10 minutes just so I don't lose a ton of progress due to bugs or just random jank is a big issue. If they had focused on bug fixes and improving the issues that are in the content already I feel like I could recommend it more to others.

I stopped playing after logging over 100 hours due to the fire update in EA, it made the game unplayable really with the amount of issues it came with. They seem to be pushing adding more content but the base of the game is just lacking so adding the extras is just like putting glitter on dirt.

Its fine to play right now but I've already had save files corrupted and deaths due to bugs/random AI. This is during the 30 hours I have put in after release. My character will still walk out into space with no helmet on which was supposed to be fixed a while ago and storage has to all be done manually. Your items don't get registered properly whether that is during task or otherwise: Batteries will be taken out of the chargers for no reason, they will stop doing everything after swapping batteries when needed and wont restart the tasks, refuses to stack items in bags and just goes one by one, character is highly unreliable I cant even get other crew due to the issues I have with one.

Its not player friendly. It can be played but I don't think majority of gamers would enjoy this game especially not as is. It can be fun but once you get killed from your ship randomly going hyper speed for no reason it becomes annoying. If they fixed the UI and focused more on the original content I think it would be worth playing. I cant recommend it in its current state. They do do regular fixes but they also add more problems by adding more content. I haven't tried the bounty system or races because I'm not confident they even work.

Buy it if you can stand jank and slog. Otherwise stay away for a few more years until its either fully threshed out or development quits.
items.text_zh:
我真的很喜欢这款游戏，可以玩上好几个小时。然而，我必须确保每5到10分钟就保存一次，以免因为bug或随机的故障而丢失大量进度，这是个很大的问题。如果他们专注于修复bug并改进现有内容中的问题，我觉得我会更愿意推荐给别人。

在早期访问的火焰更新后，我玩了超过100小时就停止玩了，它带来的大量问题真的让游戏变得没法玩。他们似乎在推动添加更多内容，但游戏的基础本身就很欠缺，所以添加额外内容就像是在泥土上撒亮片。

现在玩起来还行，但我已经遇到过存档损坏以及因bug/随机AI导致的死亡。这是在我发布后投入的30小时里发生的。我的角色仍然会不戴头盔走进太空，这本来早就该修复了，而且存储必须全部手动完成。你的物品无法正确注册，无论是在任务中还是其他情况下：电池会无缘无故从充电器中被取出，在需要时更换电池后它们会停止做所有事情，不会重新开始任务，拒绝将物品堆叠在包里，只是一件一件地放，角色非常不可靠，我甚至无法获得其他船员，因为我在一个角色上就遇到了这些问题。

它对玩家不友好。可以玩，但我认为大多数玩家不会喜欢这款游戏，尤其是现在这个样子。它可能很有趣，但一旦你的飞船无缘无故突然超高速飞行导致你死亡，就变得很烦人。如果他们修复了UI并更专注于原有内容，我认为它值得一玩。在目前的状态下我无法推荐它。他们确实定期修复，但同时也通过添加更多内容带来了更多问题。我还没试过赏金系统或竞速，因为我不确定它们是否能正常工作。

如果你能忍受故障和苦差事就买吧。否则再等几年，直到它要么完全打磨好，要么开发停止。

items.text:
There is a good game here, it is unique, dark, brutal and fun scavenging space game that does space immersion pretty well. It has been fun for the short 25 hours I have given it which took quiet a bit of Google/YouTube tutorials to learn and but it was worth the time I got out of it so far.

However, as others have mentioned, It needs more time to cook. 

It has many bugs and wonky systems, most of which are somewhat manageable but enough to feel like its still well in early access. 

The art style is great, and it suits the dark and grittiness of space exploration. Feels like you are in The Expanse universe, but the pixel art is a bit too much when it comes to identifying objects as its is a top down game with many different items stacked on and around the same single tiles and it kills the experience a bit. 

I would suggest giving it a proper follow and coming back in a few months to see if major changes/updates are being implemented before I recommend others to buy.
items.text_zh:
这里有一款好游戏，它是一款独特、黑暗、残酷且有趣的太空拾荒游戏，在太空沉浸感方面做得相当不错。在我投入的短短25小时里，它一直很有趣，这花了我不少时间通过谷歌/YouTube教程来学习，但到目前为止我从中获得的乐趣是值得的。

然而，正如其他人提到的，它还需要更多时间来打磨。

它有很多bug和不稳定的系统，其中大多数还算勉强能应付，但足以让人感觉它仍然处于早期访问阶段。

艺术风格很棒，契合太空探索的黑暗与粗粝感。感觉就像身处《苍穹浩瀚》宇宙中，但像素艺术在识别物体方面有点过于繁琐，因为这是一款俯视视角游戏，许多不同的物品堆叠在同一个格子上及其周围，这有点破坏体验。

我建议先好好关注它，过几个月再回来看看是否有重大改动/更新在实施，然后我才会推荐别人购买。

observations.description: 游戏存在许多bug和别扭的系统
observations.evidence: It has many bugs and wonky systems
observations.evidence_zh: 它有很多bug和别扭的系统

items.text: This game is not for everyone, many systems are unintuitive or frustrating, and others are buggy or unpolished.  However, I have put 200 hours into it, and can say that it scratches the itch for a complex space game with customizable ships and living quarters.  It could use alot of polish, and I must say that I think 1.0 could have been put off until that polish was there, but if you are patient enough the game is pretty relaxing.
items.text_zh: 这款游戏并不适合所有人，许多系统不直观或令人沮丧，还有一些有漏洞或未经打磨。然而，我已经投入了200个小时，可以说它满足了对一款拥有可定制飞船和居住舱室的复杂太空游戏的渴望。它需要大量的打磨，我必须说，我认为1.0版本本可以推迟到打磨完成后再发布，但如果你足够有耐心，这款游戏还是相当令人放松的。

items.text:
The state this is in, it should be in the middle of early access with 2-3 years still to go. Instead, they slapped 1.0 on it. Sure, they claim they'll add more updates, but it's hard to take such claims seriously - surely, if they intended to add substantial features, they wouldn't have left EA, right?

The game is very buggy in numerous areas, the conversation system is possibly the worst one ever created in the history of video games (just pure, dull tedium), and the entire game is puddle deep. You spend dozens of hours salvaging ship parts (the SAME ship parts over and over, since there aren't that many of them, by the way) with the only meaningful progression offered to you being the ability to upgrade your ship. You do that, finally manage to look around the system, and... find more of the same for the most part, really. Sure, you can do some trading (who cares tbh) and fighting or asteroid mining (if you spend dozens more hours on top to get to that), but it's all taking place in a DEAD world where nothing matters and everything is faked. NPCs routinely suffocate to death in their space suits inside the station because they're THAT stupid, and nobody cares, their bodies eventually despawn and they're replaced by other randomly generated NPCs. Your interaction with the world boils down to buying and selling stuff for the most part, and there's little to no story to provide variety to it. There's no real point to the game, nothing to really strive for, and the gameplay quickly becomes stale as you're caught in a repetitive grind for cash that you don't even really need that much.

It's fun when you're starting out and finding your bearings, before the grind sets in, but that's about it, really. A wasted potential kind of game. I cannot recommend this to anyone.
items.text_zh:
它现在的状态，本应处于抢先体验阶段，而且还得再等两三年。可他们却直接给它贴上了1.0的标签。当然，他们声称还会推出更多更新，但这种说法很难让人当真——如果他们真打算加入实质性的功能，肯定不会离开抢先体验阶段，对吧？

游戏在很多方面都bug频出，对话系统可能是电子游戏史上最糟糕的（纯粹是枯燥乏味的折磨），整个游戏浅薄得像一滩水。你花上几十个小时打捞飞船部件（顺便说一句，还是同样的部件一遍又一遍，因为本来就没多少种），唯一有意义的进展就是升级你的飞船。你升级完了，终于能环顾星系了，然后……发现大部分地方还是老样子，真的。当然，你可以做些贸易（说实话谁在乎啊）和战斗或者小行星采矿（如果你再花上几十个小时才能达到那一步的话），但这一切都发生在一个死寂的世界里，什么都不重要，一切都是假的。NPC们经常在空间站里穿着宇航服窒息而死，因为他们就是那么蠢，没人在乎，他们的尸体会最终消失，然后被其他随机生成的NPC取代。你和世界的互动基本上就是买卖东西，几乎没有故事来提供多样性。游戏没有真正的目标，没有什么值得追求的东西，玩法很快就变得陈旧，因为你陷入了一种重复的刷钱循环，而你其实并不那么需要钱。

刚开始玩、还在摸索的时候挺有趣的，在刷的循环开始之前，但也就仅此而已了，真的。一款潜力被浪费的游戏。我无法向任何人推荐它。

items.text:
Unfortunately, I cannot in good conscience recommend this game. I like the concept of it - starting with a small ship in mortgage, access to a ship boneyard for a nominal fee (or for free if you're good at hiding from cops) and some skills in building ships and tearing them apart. Simulated electrical systems, pressure, malfunctions such as fires or navigation station software bugging out. Build out your ship, travel the Solar System, do some stuff - questing, trading, asteriod mining, even participating in a war, good stuff, good ideas.

The problem is bad implementation. The deeper you go into the game, the more problems you find with various systems. The gases don't go through adiabatic cooling, which is reasonable for a game, so any gases you pump into your ship are at room temperature, but *sometimes* re-pressurising a room ends up with it being barely a few Kelvin hot. Characters that are prone to choosing the way around the ship if they can, doesn't matter if that way happens to go outside and they have no EVA suit on (space, remember?). Autotasking, which is basically required if you don't want to click your character through installing 400 floors and 80 walls one by one, is very bad in a lot of ways that are too long to go into details here. Barely anything happens during time skip, so if you want any work done, you'll have to let your characters do the work and go watch Youtube or something. Characters still can't replace batteries in tools without dropping flat batteries on the ground instead of properly inserting them into chargers. And speaking of tools, they will choose the first tool they find when you need one, not "the best in their inventory" or anything like that, so you need to take care to not leave old tools in any reachable places. CO2 filters never get used up, so while CO2 buildup is still bad for your character, that particular system is half-baked. Item sorting in kiosks for buying/selling is arcane.

Flight is Newtonian... to a point, it doesn't simulate gravity faithfully enough (in my opinion) and the navigation station doesn't give you enough tools to utilize the fact. Fuel isn't accounted in ship mass, which you could argue is a gameplay decision, but cargo in cargo pods does count in ship mass, so I dunno. Autopilot for interplanetary travel cheats, uses too much fuel and still smacks you into planets sometimes.

I could go on and on, but you get the idea. I have two problems with this game. I played this game for 250 hours total, about 150 hours back when I just bought it and about 100 hours near and after release. This game pulled me in enough that I tried to figure out and work around all this problems, be it by modding, adapting my processes to the s*** factor, or any other ways. But at some point my will just broke. This game is an exercise in frustration, and in the end frustration subsumes any amount of enjoyment I got out of this game. The game is full of bugs, Discord bug forum is full of bugs, and only a small amount of them gets acknowledged and even smaller about fixed. The devs say "report the bugs", but even after you report it *and provide source code for a mod that fixes it*, chances are the bug will stay in the game for weeks ahead. I don't have patience to wait for months, but some well-known problems have stayed for years, apparently, so make what you will of it. That's the first and the biggest problem. The second, as the dev's community manager eloquently put it in Discord, "this game's elevator pitch is Firefly episode generator". There is a reason I'm indifferent to Firefly as opposed to Star Trek, and it's the setting. This game won't tell you power draw or any other specs for spaceship equipment. It won't tell you how much thrust thrusters produce or how far sensors can detect things. You're supposed to wing it. I don't like it.

By the way, I like Rimworld. Rimworld is also a "story generator". It's also a lot, lot, lot better implementation-wise than this game. Don't get fooled by comparison.

So there it is. Apparently this game has a deep simulation for characters relations, mental needs etcetc, but it was too arcane for me to figure it out, so I just ignored it. As is the norm for the game, it won't tell you anything, you're supposed to figure things out. Maybe this is not a one-guy-or-small-team-flying-spaceship simulation game but a dating simulator in space with elements of shipbuilding? I dunno. If you want to get the game, make absolutely sure your expectations match what it is.
items.text_zh:
遗憾的是，我无法凭良心推荐这款游戏。我喜欢它的概念——从一艘还在按揭的小船开始，可以花点小钱（或者如果你擅长躲警察就免费）进入飞船坟场，还有一些建造和拆解飞船的技能。模拟电气系统、压力、火灾或导航站软件故障等故障。建造你的飞船，在太阳系中旅行，做些事情——任务、贸易、小行星采矿，甚至参与战争，好东西，好想法。

问题在于糟糕的实现。你在游戏中越深入，就会发现各种系统的问题越多。气体不会经历绝热冷却，这对游戏来说还算合理，所以你泵入飞船的任何气体都是室温的，但*有时候*给房间重新加压后，它却只有几开尔文的温度。角色倾向于选择绕飞船的路，如果可能的话，不管那条路是否会通到外面，而他们又没穿EVA服（太空，记得吗？）。自动任务分配，如果你不想一个个点击角色安装400块地板和80面墙，基本上就是必需的，但它在很多方面都非常糟糕，细节太长这里就不展开了。时间跳过期间几乎什么都不会发生，所以如果你想完成任何工作，你就得让角色干活，自己去看YouTube什么的。角色仍然无法更换工具里的电池，而是把没电的电池扔在地上，而不是正确地插入充电器。说到工具，当你需要一个工具时，他们会选择找到的第一个工具，而不是“他们库存中最好的”之类的，所以你得小心，不要把旧工具留在任何可触及的地方。CO2过滤器永远不会用完，所以虽然CO2积累对你的角色仍然有害，但那个特定系统是半生不熟的。售货亭里买卖物品的分类方式神秘莫测。

飞行是牛顿式的……到一定程度，它（在我看来）没有足够忠实地模拟重力，导航站也没有给你足够的工具来利用这一事实。燃料不计入飞船质量，你可以说这是游戏性决定，但货舱里的货物确实计入飞船质量，所以我不知道。行星际旅行的自动驾驶作弊，使用过多燃料，有时还会把你撞进行星。

我可以继续说下去，但你明白意思了。我对这款游戏有两个问题。我总共玩了250小时，大约150小时是我刚买的时候，大约100小时是在发布前后。这款游戏足够吸引我，以至于我试图弄清楚并绕过所有这些问题，无论是通过模组、调整我的流程来适应这坨屎，还是其他方式。但到了某个时候，我的意志就崩溃了。这款游戏是一场挫折的练习，最终挫折感吞没了我从中获得的任何乐趣。游戏充满bug，Discord的bug论坛充满bug，只有一小部分被承认，被修复的就更少了。开发者说“报告bug”，但即使你报告了*并且提供了修复它的模组源代码*，这个bug很可能还会在游戏中停留数周。我没有耐心等几个月，但一些众所周知的问题显然已经存在多年了，所以你自己看着办吧。这是第一个也是最大的问题。第二个，正如开发者的社区经理在Discord上雄辩地说的，“这款
游戏的电梯游说是“萤火虫剧集生成器”。我对《萤火虫》不像对《星际迷航》那样感兴趣是有原因的，那就是它的设定。这款游戏不会告诉你飞船设备的功耗或任何其他规格。它不会告诉你推进器产生多少推力，或者传感器能探测到多远的东西。你应该自己随机应变。我不喜欢这样。

顺便说一句，我喜欢《环世界》。《环世界》也是一个“故事生成器”。在实现方面，它也比这款游戏好得多得多得多。别被这种比较骗了。

所以就是这样。显然，这款游戏对角色关系、心理需求等有深度模拟，但对我来说太晦涩难懂了，所以我干脆忽略了它。就像这款游戏的常态一样，它什么都不会告诉你，你应该自己去弄明白。也许这不是一个单人或小团队驾驶飞船的模拟游戏，而是一个带有造船元素的太空约会模拟器？我不知道。如果你想买这款游戏，一定要绝对确保你的期望与它的实际内容相符。

items.text:
I bought it when it was in like 0.1.2.1 or something like this. Back then it was buggy as hell. It felt like a pulp of features mixed together with no solid project in mind. But I wanted to like it, so I decided to wait for the full release, with way less bugs, more content and especially a better tutorial which shows exactly how this game works. 

I was happy at first when 1.0.0 was annouced, but I quickly noticed that almost nothing changed in terms of my complains. This game is a mess. And my biggest complain is that it feels like the author has ADHD and randomly created a very detailed feature, without explaining it anyhow. For example, something that simple as talking to NPC, I have no idea what's going on there, and the game doesn't explain it either.

I can easily tell that this game is unreasonably deep in some mechanics (like a talking to the NPC mentioned earlier) and at the same time straight up shallow in some other places.

In my opinion the tutorial should be a few hours long, like a campaign that guides you through every mechanics this game has to offer. Not just a basics of scavening, even if that's the main core of the gameplay.

I can't recommend it at it's current state, IT STILL FEELS LIKE AN ALPHA VERSION.
But I put huge hopes in this project and will try it again some time later. I hope my review will change next time.
items.text_zh:
我是在它还是0.1.2.1之类的版本时买的。那时候它bug多得像地狱。感觉就像一堆功能被胡乱拼凑在一起，背后没有一个扎实的项目规划。但我很想喜欢它，所以我决定等正式版发布，那时bug会少得多，内容更多，尤其是会有一个更好的教程，能确切地展示这游戏是怎么运作的。

1.0.0公布时我一开始很高兴，但我很快注意到，就我抱怨的那些问题而言，几乎什么都没变。这游戏一团糟。而我最大的抱怨是，感觉作者有ADHD，会随机地做出一个非常细致的功能，却完全不加任何解释。比如说，像和NPC对话这么简单的事，我完全不知道那里在发生什么，游戏也不解释。

我很容易就能看出，这游戏在某些机制上深得毫无道理（比如前面提到的和NPC对话），同时在其他一些地方又直白地浅薄。

在我看来，教程应该长达几个小时，像一场战役一样，引导你了解这游戏提供的每一个机制。而不只是拾荒的基础知识，哪怕那才是玩法的核心。

以它目前的状态，我无法推荐它，它仍然感觉像是一个ALPHA版本。
但我对这个项目寄予厚望，过段时间会再试一次。希望下次我的评价能有所改变。

items.text:
Its a good game.
Well, there a bugs. Many of them actually. Not release Cyberpunk 2077 but more like todays Cyberpunk 2077. (Fantastic game if you haven't played it, here's my cross game propaganda, play it ;) )
But maybe i just love these engineering type games too much, because even with those bugs i love this game.
I spent 120 hours on my first play through and i am still going. In this game you start as a corp slave salvaging for fractions of a penny on the dollar of the stuff you bring the company. The main plot point of the game is to go from rags to riches so you quit your job take a loan and buy a ship (there are a few starter ships, some better than others).

Now that the character creation is over you are let loose into the scrapyard yourself, get into your ship and start scrapping derelicts, the game features a 2D landscape that you can move around in, Flying your ship feels nice, managing the relative velocity to your target with the fuel you have sometimes needs a bit of planning, in the early game inconsequential but once you learn to love some of the other less used modules (well get to that later) and your ships get bigger (that also comes further down), planning and executing a boost that will change your trajectory to reach your target in a more favorable angle a long way later is a nice thing and feels cool to execute. Once close to your target (5km) you can then dock where you need to line up with the docking port of the to be docked ship with your own docking port, then clamp to it. This can prove rather difficult if you have a lot of cross-velocity trying to push you off. Looking at you VORB, you will get what i mean if you play the game.

NOW we get to the really cool stuff, building the ship up. You have a basic ship that has life support (hopefully, not all do) When you enter a derelict you can scrap it for parts (this is the main way to do income early game and kind of your job to yourself), later new avenues of income open up but for now its scrapping. So grab your tools board a derelict and start unscrewing those juicy parts (dont forget your trusty pressure suit), like thrusters, nav consoles, fuel intakes, gas pumps, scrubbers and sooooo on... but now the magic happens. You could sell these for credits BUT you can also just build them into your own ship. This is the part i love most and is A if not THE core aspect. So grab some walls some floors some conduits for power and start expanding your own ship, just remember that more mass needs more fuel to move the same distance in the same time, but usually comes with more space so more salvage. First thing you should do is if your ship does not have an air pump with an oxygen canister attached to it, that first, definite that first. Besides that the sky is your limit, or the space in this case? Irrelevant. Let your creativity out to create a ship, that is not only nice to look at and useful but most importantly it is yours. Its not like where you buy something like a vehicle in another game where you choose between 7 rovers that all have the same stats, You can custom build the ship. You build what you need, you can create specialization out of generalists. You do the walling, flooring, cabling, every machine in there is for you to build where you want. It is YOUR ship when you're done.

Things like the NAV console, the navigation terminal is a board where all modules on it are - well - modular, you can rearrange, remove and add new modules to it to create a layout and functionality you like. Some modules are essentially useless in the early game, like the time advance view of the solar system, in the early game serving little use but it becomes a vital tool for interplanetary travel. The reactor, Perhaps one of my favorite things in the game, the modular reactor (the parts used for its functionality are) by objective standards not the greatest and in-depth part of the game but i have a weakness for such machines. Knobs and buttons, so many knobs and buttons. While operation is simple and takes 10 seconds max once you're just going through it on a routine, it feels nice to generally press these buttons in the whole game actually and turn dials. If you get into interplanetary freight, remember that thirteen helium-3 tanks and one deuterium tank is the ratio that will get you the farthest, i read 12.7 : 1 to be more precise. Lets talk about a part i wish was more fleshed out (besides the fusion reactor mechanics), logic. LOGIC, in the sense of, Machine A do this when Machine B does that, example: Oxygen pump turn on when oxygen sensor triggers alarm. This is about the depth of the logic system, there are wire boxes that allow for logical comparisons like "AND" or "OR" but the applications are currently limited, you cant for example wire it to a door to get a signal if its open or closed to create automatic airlocks. Which i find a large missed opportunity.

I should mention there is AI crew you can hire, buuuuuuut i dont have enough experience (2 minutes before reloading a save) to talk about them. But what i can say is that there is a social system in the game, it is a life noir after all. So maybe besides helping with work they can be of use as emotional sandbags too.

I am in the mid to late game i think, I left scrapping behind and now do interplanetary bulk freight (one of many other ways to make a living). While solo is probably not the intended way to play the game, it is the way i choose and its working out good enough :)

Thanks for reading :3
items.text_zh:
这是个好游戏。
好吧，有bug。实际上很多。不是发售时的《赛博朋克2077》，而更像是如今的《赛博朋克2077》。（如果你还没玩过，那是个绝佳的游戏，这是我跨游戏的安利，去玩吧 ;) ）
但也许我只是太喜欢这类工程类游戏了，因为即使有那些bug，我也爱这个游戏。
我第一次通关花了120个小时，而且我还在继续玩。在这个游戏里，你一开始是个公司奴隶，为你带给公司的东西打捞，只换来几分钱。游戏的主要情节是从赤贫到暴富，所以你辞掉工作，贷款买一艘船（有几艘初始船，有些比其他的好）。

现在角色创建结束了，你被放进了废料场，进入你的船，开始拆解废弃飞船，游戏有一个2D的景观，你可以在其中移动，驾驶你的船感觉很好，用你拥有的燃料管理与你目标的相对速度有时需要一点规划，在游戏早期无关紧要，但一旦你学会爱上一些其他较少使用的模块（我们稍后会谈到）并且你的船变得更大（那也在后面），规划并执行一次能改变你轨迹的加速，以便在很远的距离后以更有利的角度到达你的目标，是一件很美好的事，执行起来感觉很酷。一旦接近你的目标（5公里），你就可以对接，你需要将你的对接端口与要对接的船的对接端口对齐，然后夹住它。如果你有很多横向速度试图把你推开，这可能会相当困难。说的就是你，VORB，如果你玩这个游戏，你会明白我的意思。

现在我们来到真正酷的东西，建造飞船。你有一艘基本飞船，有生命维持系统（希望如此，不是所有都有）当你进入一艘废弃飞船时，你可以拆解它获取零件（这是游戏早期赚取收入的主要方式，也算是你给自己打工），后来新的收入途径会打开，但现在就是拆解。所以拿起你的工具，登上一艘废弃飞船，开始拧下那些 juicy 的零件（别忘了你信赖的压力服），比如推进器、导航控制台、燃料进气口、气泵、洗涤器等等等等……但现在魔法发生了。你可以把这些卖掉换信用点，但你也可以直接把它们建到自己的飞船里。这是我最喜欢的部分，是，如果不是核心方面的话。所以拿些墙壁、地板、一些电力导管，开始扩展你自己的飞船，只要记住更多的质量需要更多的燃料才能在相同时间内移动相同的距离，但通常会带来更多空间，所以更多打捞。你应该做的第一件事是，如果你的飞船没有连接氧气罐的空气泵，那就先做那个，绝对先做那个。除此之外，天空是你的极限，或者在这种情况下是太空？无关紧要。释放你的创造力来创造一艘船，不仅好看实用，最重要的是它是你的。不像在其他游戏里你买一辆车，在7辆属性相同的漫游车之间选择，你可以自定义建造飞船。你建造你需要的，你可以把通才变成专才。你做墙壁、地板、布线，里面的每一台机器都由你决定建在哪里。完成后，它是你的飞船。

像导航控制台，导航终端是一个板子，上面所有模块都是——嗯——模块化的，你可以重新排列、移除和添加新模块，创造你喜欢的布局和功能。有些模块在游戏早期基本上没用，比如太阳系的时间推进视图，在早期没什么用，但它成为星际旅行的重要工具。反应堆，也许是游戏里我最喜欢的东西之一，模块化反应堆（用于其功能的部件是）按客观标准来说不是游戏中最伟大、最深入的部分，但我对这种机器有弱点。旋钮和按钮，那么多旋钮和按钮。虽然操作很简单，一旦你只是例行公事地操作，最多10秒，但在整个游戏中按下这些按钮和转动旋钮的感觉很好。如果你进入星际货运，记住十三个氦-3罐和一个氘罐是能让你走得最远的比例，我读到更精确的是12.7：1。让我们谈谈一个我希望更充实的部分（除了聚变反应堆机制），逻辑。逻辑，意思是，机器A在机器B做某事时做这个，例如：氧气泵在氧气传感器触发警报时打开。这大约是逻辑系统的深度，有接线盒允许逻辑比较，如“与”或“或”，但应用目前有限，例如你不能把它接到门上，在门打开或关闭时获得信号，以创建自动气闸。我觉得这是一个巨大的错失机会。

我应该提到有AI船员可以雇佣，但但但但我没有足够的经验（重新加载存档前2分钟）来谈论他们。但我能说的是游戏里有一个社交系统，毕竟这是一个生活黑色游戏。所以也许除了帮助工作，他们也可以作为情感沙袋有用。

我想我处于中后期游戏，我离开了拆解，现在做星际散货运输（许多其他谋生方式之一）。虽然单人可能不是游戏的预期玩法，但这是我选择的方式，而且效果足够好 :)

感谢阅读 :3

items.text:
Игра, сама по себе, абсолютно уникальная. Очень аутентичный симулятор разборщика космических кораблей - свой личный можно собрать чуть ли не из того же мусора, превращая каждый разбор в своеобразный квест. Что не нужно, но дорого - отправить на продажу, этот пол и стены отлично ляжут рядом с моим - отправить в трюм и собрать из этого новый отсек. Приземленность всего происходящего действительно цепляет. Приходится следить за стрессом, голодом, жаждой, сном, даже туалетом - из-за этого со временем к своему кораблю привыкаешь как к детищу, зная предназначения каждых его закоулков. То, что вчера было железной коробкой спустя 50 часов превращается в самодостаточное пространство с бесконечной генерацией электричества, спальней, качалкой, кухней, курилкой, зоной для развлечения - да все, чего вашей душе угодно, благо с необходимостью путешествовать между планетами на посудине придется проводить недели не выходя.

Проблемы, в целом, начинаются практически сразу. Игра банально недоготовлена. Ваш стресс, например, это набор из 10 параметров, начиная от одиночества, заканчивая чувством собственной важности, держать в узде которые предлагают с помощью социального взаимодействия. Задумка интересная - любого НПС можно попытаться сделать своим другом, врагом, любовником - что угодно. Вот только сама система это какой-то нелепый набор из 20 действий, повышающих одни параметры и уменьшающих другие, из-за чего диалоги зачастую превращаются в закликивание одной опции 30 раз с результатом, который... даже не понятен? За одно нажатие ваши статы будут прыгать ТРИЖДЫ. Из-за этого трогать эту систему банально не хочется, оставляя ее либо на автоматизацию, либо используя другие, более простые методы. И так во многом - в Ostranauts действительно уйма механик, и лишь примерно треть из них кажется оформленной до конца. 

И все это было бы ничего, знаете, был в свое время такой разработчик - Питер Молинье - в каждой игре предлагал миллиард уникальных механик, и каждая выходила либо без них, либо с урезанными их версиями. Но в его играх всегда был шарм, уникальность никуда не девалась, держала тебя у экрана. И первые часов 40 я думал, что это первый на моей памяти пример своеобразного Молинье-лайка - абсолютно недоработанного проекта, который, однако, крайне увлекает. 

Так почему же, вы спросите, обзор негативный? Потому что игры Молинье [b]работали[/b].

Ostranauts это не 1.0. Даже близко нет. Эта игра НАВОДНЕНА багами. Вы будете встречать их повсюду, в каждой из игровых механик. Но до какого-то момента их можно терпеть. Можно терпеть тупейший АИ, можно терпеть НПС, которые выходят в космос без скафандра, неработающие опции в диалогах, лицензии, который меняют свою дату по истечению - это все можно терпеть. Но я рекомендую всем вылететь дальше первой локации и понять, что помимо, как мне кажется, двух третей фанбазы. там не были даже сами разработчики. Прилетев на Венеру понимаешь, что, ну, им просто наплевать. Каждый шаг вокруг Венеры забагован и мешает играть. Сюжетные миссии не работают. Летный интерфейс ломается после использования движка. Игра симулирует гравитацию Венеры и делает это НЕПРАВИЛЬНО - отталкивая от себя корабли вместо притяжения. 

И, казалось бы, ну окей. маленькая компания, инди, =терпим=, но если пооставлять баг-репорты и последить за реакцией на них разработчиков, то становится предельно ясно, что эта игра никогда не избавится от багов. 

Я, в целом, любитель поддержать мелкие проекты, оставить так называемый фидбек, порепортить баги - в общем, помочь сделать игру лучше. Так вот за свое время игры я оставил, кажется, семь баг репортов, реакцию получив на два, за две недели не исправлен не был ни один, даже из каких-то банальных, по типу неисчезающего со временем статуса "мозоли". Многие вещи, которые я встретил, я не репортил потому, что их репортили другие люди год назад - и с тех пор было ноль движений. Вы в какой нибудь игре видели, чтобы человек жаловался на кажущийся баг с гравитацией Венеры, получал какой-то жидкий ответ от разраба, шел и декомпилировал игру, находил строчку с ошибкой в коде, указывал на нее разрабам и не получал фикса в течение двух недель? Звучит как полный сюр, но маэстро за рулем Ostranauts так не думают. Те патчи, что выходят - это курам на смех. Там исправлений с десяток, но посты делают такие огромные, будто в каждом фиксов 100 - не меньше. 

В общем не тратьте свои деньги. Я редко согласен с подобными высказываниями, но игра сейчас натурально в какой-то бете, где все еще нормально (с большой натяжкой) сделана лишь первая локация. Да, собрать свой крупный корабль с нуля, научиться им управлять, чувствовать себя в нем уютно, чтобы прожить в нем неделю для успешного недельного полета на другую планету - это незабываемые чувства. Вот только на каждом шагу вам будут мешать, у вас будет что-то ломаться, а по прибытию вы увидите места, где не ступала нога не человека, а разработчика, который ввел эту зону 2 года назад и с тех пор, видимо, не трогал. Это все того не стоит.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏本身绝对独一无二。非常真实的拆解宇宙飞船模拟器——你几乎可以用同样的垃圾拼凑出自己的私人飞船，把每一次拆解变成一种独特的任务。不需要但很贵的东西——送去卖掉，这块地板和墙壁跟我的正好搭配——送进货舱，用它拼出一个新舱室。整个过程的接地气确实很抓人。你必须关注压力、饥饿、口渴、睡眠，甚至上厕所——因此随着时间推移，你会对自己的飞船像对自己的孩子一样习惯，知道它每个角落的用途。昨天还是个铁盒子，50小时后变成一个自给自足的空间，有无限的电力生成、卧室、健身房、厨房、吸烟区、娱乐区——只要你的心想要什么都有，好在由于必须乘坐这艘船在行星之间旅行，你得在里面待上几周不出来。

问题总体上几乎从一开始就出现了。游戏简直没做完。比如你的压力，是一组10个参数，从孤独到自我重要感，建议通过社交互动来控制它们。想法很有趣——任何NPC都可以试着变成你的朋友、敌人、情人——什么都行。只是这个系统本身是一套由20个动作组成的荒谬集合，提高一些参数、降低另一些，导致对话常常变成把同一个选项点30次，结果……甚至看不懂？一次点击你的属性会跳三次。因此根本不想碰这个系统，要么把它交给自动化，要么使用其他更简单的方法。很多地方都是这样——Ostranauts确实有大量机制，但其中大约只有三分之一看起来是完整做好的。

这一切本来也没什么，你知道，以前有这么个开发者——彼得·莫利纽——他在每款游戏里都提出十亿个独特机制，而每款游戏发售时要么没有这些机制，要么是它们的阉割版。但他的游戏总是有魅力，独特性从未消失，让你一直坐在屏幕前。前40个小时左右我以为这是我记忆中第一个类似莫利纽式的例子——一个绝对没做完的项目，却极其引人入胜。

那么你问，为什么是差评？因为莫利纽的游戏[b]是能运行的[/b]。

Ostranauts不是1.0。差得远。这款游戏被bug淹没了。你会在各处遇到它们，在每一个游戏机制里。但到某个时刻之前还能忍。可以忍受最愚蠢的AI，可以忍受不穿宇航服就进入太空的NPC、对话里不工作的选项、到期后改变日期的许可证——这些都能忍。但我建议所有人都飞出第一个地点之外，然后明白，除了我认为的三分之二粉丝群体之外，那里连开发者自己都没去过。飞到金星后你会明白，嗯，他们根本不在乎。金星周围的每一步都有bug，妨碍游玩。剧情任务不工作。飞行界面在使用引擎后就会坏掉。游戏模拟金星重力，而且做得不对——把飞船推开而不是吸引。

而且，看起来，好吧。小公司，独立，=忍了=，但如果留下bug报告并观察开发者对它们的反应，就会极其清楚地明白，这款游戏永远不会摆脱bug。

总的来说，我是个喜欢支持小项目、留下所谓反馈、报告bug的人——总之，帮助让游戏变得更好。所以在我游玩的时间里，我大概留下了七个bug报告，收到回应的有两个，两周内一个都没被修复，甚至包括一些很普通的，比如随时间不消失的“老茧”状态。我遇到的很多东西我没有报告，因为别人一年前就报告过——而从那以后零进展。你在哪款游戏里见过，有人抱怨金星重力的疑似bug，从开发者那里得到某种敷衍的回复，去反编译游戏，找到代码里出错的那一行，向开发者指出它，然后两周内都没得到修复？听起来完全荒诞，但Ostranauts的掌舵大师不这么认为。那些发布的补丁简直是笑话。里面大概有十来个修复，但帖子写得那么大，好像每个补丁里至少有100个修复。

总之别浪费你的钱。我很少同意这类说法，但游戏现在真的处于某种测试阶段，其中仍然（非常勉强地）做得还算正常的只有第一个地点。是的，从零开始拼出自己的大型飞船，学会驾驶它，在里面感到舒适，为了成功进行为期一周飞往另一颗行星的航行而在里面生活一周——这是难忘的感觉。只是每一步都会有人妨碍你，你会有东西坏掉，而到达后你会看到连人都没踏足过的地方，更别说开发者了，他在两年前引入了这个区域，从那以后显然没碰过。这一切都不值得。
总之，帮助让游戏变得更好。所以在我玩游戏的这段时间里，我大概留下了七份bug报告，只收到了两份的回应，两周内一个都没被修复，甚至是一些很普通的，比如那个不会随时间消失的“老茧”状态。我遇到的很多东西我都没报告，因为别人一年前就报告过了——而从那以后就是零进展。你在哪款游戏里见过，有人抱怨一个看似是金星重力bug的问题，从开发者那里得到某种敷衍的回复，然后去反编译游戏，在代码里找到出错的那一行，向开发者指出它，却在两周内都没得到修复？听起来完全是荒诞剧，但Ostranauts的掌舵大师们不这么认为。那些发布的补丁简直是笑话。里面也就十来个修复，但发的帖子搞得那么大，好像每个补丁里至少有100个修复似的。

总之别浪费你的钱。我很少同意这类说法，但游戏现在真的处于某种测试阶段，其中还勉强（非常勉强）算做得像样的只有第一个地点。是的，从零开始造一艘自己的大型飞船，学会驾驶它，在里面感到舒适，为了成功进行为期一周飞往另一颗行星的航行而在里面生活一周——这是难忘的感受。只不过每一步都会有人妨碍你，你总会有东西坏掉，而到达之后你会看到那些连人、不，连开发者的脚都没踏过的地方，那个开发者两年前引入了这个区域，从那以后显然就没碰过。这一切都不值得。

items.text:
6/10
 -- [!! F U N !!   BUT   D I S A P O I N T I N G] --

My hour count is a result of a lack of games to play, nevertheless,  this game has been fun but at every moment past the 15hr mark I've thought to myself "where's the content?"

Essentially if you're the type that enjoys grindy and overly complicated complete freedom sandbox games (kenshi, rimworld, etc), then you'll enjoy it, but likely come to the same opinion as me.

------------------------------------------
SHIP BUILDING AND DESIGN LACKS SERIOUS DEPTH
      Half the game is grinding away at building your space ship, yet there is so little to build decoration and functionality wise. You have two types of chairs, three types of tables, and no real interior decoration other than painfully matching correct floor variants you rarely find (like 5 decor items I can think of that aren't those).
     For functional parts, you just need a ship battery, thruster, pilot seat, and two air pumps (one for O2 and N2). Then you have your fully functional space ship with it's core systems and sadly, it doesn't get much more in depth than that beyond building your first ship's fusion reactor. Like theres no need to build a dedicated life support room on your ship, managing lifesupport systems is as simple as placing an air pump inside a room. It doesn't even matter where you place your thrusters, sensors, or anything. As long as if it's on the ship it flies. It just really feels lackluster, like there's no solar panels, no ship shield room to set-up, no crafting room, etc. The variety for what is there is also very limited. You'd expect water to be an important resource in space, but it's not here. You'll just be storing gallons in your fridge.
-------------------------------------------
LACKING LOOT VARIETY
You'll always be finding the same exact stuff in chests and crates aboard every single ship. Its not exciting.
------------------------------------------
WORTHLESS TRAITS
Theres a wide plethora of traits in character creation, half of which no one has any clue as to what they do. Is cooking a hobby? Well thats never coming up again, and your not going to be cooking anything because its not a feature. Theres just so much that does truely nothing
------------------------------------------
LACKING QOL
There's just so so so much QOL that is lacking, especially when it comes to ship design. Character pathfinding is awful and dumb. Theres a ship building mode in the game, but you cannot import your designs or ANYTHING made in that mode to the real game. There is no planning mode. Darkness always makes building difficult, you can never get a full view of your ship you are working on. To remedy this you can use a 'visor' such as a 'price visor' which removes the darkness and color codes items by their relative value. But in that mode you cannot see any orders you have issued, any walls you set to be constructed, flooring you just ordered your character to put down, etc.
------------------------------------------
VERY ANNOYING CHARACTER NEED BAR MANAGEMENT
Your character has mental needs, such as socialization, talking to family, etc. To solve these it is a tedious task of right clicking your character, and pressing the correct hotkey that lowers the need bar over 20 times or be penalized stat wise. Im not joking, it's incredibly stupid. You will literally spend 3 minutes IRL spam clicking "browse social media, long for a better love life, remember family, etc" to make your need bars go down to keep your character happy. These systems ARE NOT ENGAGING IN ANY WAY and are my biggest gripe with the game.
------------------------------------------
!! BUGGY & UNOPTIMIZED!!
Admittedly, I haven't experience a save breaking bug a save and reload can't fix, but it's annoying coming across bugs that require you to reload the game in order to continue playing. Also, runs a bit hot for what it is and saving and loading takes ages.
------------------------------------------

-- THE REASON THIS IS A POSITIVE REVIEW STILL --
At the end of it all, I still enjoy this game but am disappointed constantly. What is keeping me playing is the exploration and that sense of progression. There really is a ton to explore, space is huge in this game. But the progression is what is really keeping me coming back, you start with rags and work your way to riches and that is just incredibly fun and well done in this game.
items.text_zh:
6/10
 -- [!! 有 趣 !!   但   令 人 失 望] --

我的游戏时长是因为没什么别的游戏可玩，尽管如此，这游戏一直挺有趣，但过了15小时之后，我每时每刻都在想“内容在哪？”

基本上，如果你是那种喜欢肝、过于复杂、完全自由的沙盒游戏（kenshi、rimworld等）的人，那你会喜欢它，但很可能最终得出和我一样的看法。

------------------------------------------
飞船建造和设计严重缺乏深度
      游戏的一半时间都花在建造你的太空飞船上，但在装饰和功能方面可建造的东西却少得可怜。你只有两种椅子、三种桌子，除了那些你很少能找到的、需要痛苦地匹配正确的地板变体之外，没有任何真正的室内装饰（我能想到的除了那些之外大概只有5种装饰物品）。
     至于功能部件，你只需要一个飞船电池、推进器、驾驶座和两个气泵（一个用于O2，一个用于N2）。然后你就有了拥有核心系统的完全可用的太空飞船，可悲的是，除了建造你第一艘飞船的聚变反应堆之外，它并不会变得更有深度。就像你不需要在飞船上建造专门的生命维持室，管理生命维持系统就像在房间里放一个气泵一样简单。你把推进器、传感器或其他任何东西放在哪里都无所谓。只要它在飞船上，它就能飞。这真的让人感觉很乏味，就像没有太阳能板、没有需要设置的飞船护盾室、没有制作室等等。现有的东西种类也非常有限。你会以为水在太空中是一种重要资源，但这里不是。你只会把几加仑水储存在冰箱里。
-------------------------------------------
战利品缺乏多样性
你在每一艘飞船上的箱子和板条箱里总是会找到完全相同的东西。这并不令人兴奋。
------------------------------------------
毫无价值的特质
角色创建中有大量特质，其中一半没人知道它们到底有什么用。烹饪是一种爱好吗？嗯，这再也不会出现了，而且你也不会烹饪任何东西，因为它不是一个功能。有太多东西真的什么都不做
------------------------------------------
缺乏生活质量改进
缺乏的生活质量改进实在是太多太多了，尤其是在飞船设计方面。角色寻路糟糕又愚蠢。游戏里有一个飞船建造模式，但你不能把你的设计或在该模式中制作的任何东西导入到真正的游戏中。没有规划模式。黑暗总是让建造变得困难，你永远无法完整地看到你正在建造的飞船。为了解决这个问题，你可以使用一个“面罩”，比如“价格面罩”，它会消除黑暗并根据物品的相对价值给它们上色。但在那个模式下，你看不到你发出的任何命令、你设置为要建造的任何墙壁、你刚刚命令角色铺设的地板等等。
------------------------------------------
非常烦人的角色需求条管理
你的角色有心理需求，比如社交、与家人交谈等等。要解决这些需求，就得繁琐地右键点击你的角色，然后按正确的热键超过20次来降低需求条，否则就会受到属性惩罚。我不是开玩笑，这蠢得难以置信。你真的会花3分钟在现实中狂点“浏览社交媒体、渴望更好的爱情生活、想念家人等等”，让你的需求条降下来，以保持你的角色开心。这些系统在任何方面都毫无吸引力，是我对这游戏最大的不满。
------------------------------------------
!! 有BUG且未优化!!
诚然，我还没有遇到过保存并重新加载无法修复的坏档BUG，但遇到需要你重新加载游戏才能继续玩的BUG还是很烦人。而且，就它这个体量来说，运行起来有点烫，保存和加载也要花很长时间。
------------------------------------------

-- 这仍然是一条好评的原因 --
归根结底，我仍然喜欢这个游戏，但也不断感到失望。让我继续玩下去的是探索和那种进步感。确实有大量东西可以探索，这个游戏里的太空非常巨大。但真正让我不断回来的是进度推进，你从衣衫褴褛开始，一路努力走向富有，这在这游戏里真的非常有趣，而且做得很好。
让你的角色保持开心。这些系统在任何方面都毫无吸引力，是我对这款游戏最大的不满。
------------------------------------------
！！有漏洞且未优化！！
诚然，我还没遇到过保存并重新加载无法修复的坏档漏洞，但遇到需要重新加载游戏才能继续游玩的漏洞还是很烦人。另外，就它这个体量而言，运行起来有点烫，而且保存和加载要花很长时间。
------------------------------------------

—— 这仍然是一条好评的原因 ——
归根结底，我仍然喜欢这款游戏，但也不断感到失望。让我继续玩下去的是探索和那种成长感。这款游戏里真的有太多东西可以探索，太空非常浩瀚。但真正让我不断回来的还是成长进程，你从衣衫褴褛起步，一路打拼到腰缠万贯，而这在这款游戏里就是极其有趣，而且做得非常好。

items.text:
Really big shame, I was super excited for this game to be finished but their final release state is just ridiculous. To give the clearest summary possible, typing 'version 1.0' does not actually mean a thing is now 1.0. The game isn't finished, and it almost explicitely tells you that it isn't finished. Most of the map is still placeholder stations, the only fully fleshed out and finished areas seem to be OKLG, Venus, and MAYBE Ceres. If you dock at a station and the text pop-up ends with 'maybe someday pilots will be able to do more than trading,' that is the game telling you 'this is not a finished area.' My question is, if more than half the stations aren't finished, how is this a 1.0 release? How do you go from version 0.15 to 1.0 when you have so much more work to do? Imo, just call 0.15 a 1.0 version and remove the 'early access' tag.

The AI is still bad, they will choke themselves to death in space suits, if they are auto-tasked to haul stuff when their hands are full they will walk to the item and then cancel the task (because they don't know to put down what's in their hand/s,) there's no category for zones separating parts and whole ship pieces ('I want to put electronic parts like motherboards and scrap here, but I have to pick a category that will also cause the crew to haul whole computers and batteries that I don't need.) 

Relating to the above, the person-to-person combat and station security desperately needed more done to it. You can kill an entire station by venting the walls and then just fly off. If security dock with your ship to fine or arrest you 99% of the time you can win the fist fight with them and act like nothing happened. I guess something that would've fixed this is giving the security forces' ships some kind of weaponry, but frankly what REALLY needs to happen is adding more to the personnel combat so there's more challenge to different fights. Security forces having a partner, or adding in armour items, or adding more combat moves, etc. Piracy, or the piracy I've seen, has been some loser on a derelict with brass knuckles popping out and saying 'cough up the goods' before they're ventilated with a pistol. Like, lol, what? I haven't once had difficulty with personnel combat in the game thusfar. Even if there's more to it later on, I do not believe 65 hours is not long enough to see things pick up.
Update: In an area with more pirates, and found an AI issue with the personnel combat. The enemy AI seems to be unaware when they have firearms and will not engage in combat at all. I took out three pirates armed with pistols because instead of fighting back, they repeatedly demanded I surrender while being shot repeatedly. They didn't even try to use melee when I was standing directly infront of them for roughly five minutes. Hostile boarders also don't seem to understand that they're hostile boarders and won't go into my ship to attack me, they just stay in their ship. Also, anyone who isn't hostile who tries to dock with your ship (like if you make an SOS out of fuel call, or when NASS patrols dock for an inspection/issue fines,) they come in too hot, smash the ships together, and end up killing themselves.

Optimization is bad, randomly, for reasons I am completely lost on. The game will enter into a massive slowdown, or refuse to save, or freeze, or take forever to save. When you're on max speed torch driving on a 4 day trip, if you enter these slowdowns the AI can also freeze and cancel their own auto-orders. 

The gameplay loop is fun, but poorly implimented. The game effectively says you're a salvager, this is technically true and technically false. You START as a salvager, but this stops being worth it as you get later into the game. At bare minimum you need to be a space trucker once you get a torch drive, the time investment vs profit of salvage compared to cargo incentivizes cargo. Bounty hunting is in the game, but to do it you need to buy weapons, which are only sold at some stations (which are still placeholders,) and they are far enough away that you won't be able to get there for literal days of playing the game. After 65 hours, I haven't been able to get into ship combat at all. It's an extremely weird thing, when there ARE many systems in the game, but you won't be able to see them for days of irl time and need to go to unfinished parts of the game to get what you need to engage with it.

Personal gripe this time, but I really wish there was more horror/supernatural/strange elements. Someone could argue they're there, but rare, but I'd disagree. There is one major event early on, and once its solved you won't see anything. Atleast, I haven't seen anything else.

I haven't finished the main storyline, but I still have criticisms here regardless. Without spoilers, there has been very little story crossover with the game mechanics. Only the meat storyline affects the game that I've seen. To emphasize, I've played 95 hours total, 65.8 since release, and one storyline actually introduced something that affected how I play. I understand Neo Scavenger also used text screens for its story, but this game isn't played the same way. Combat is not done through text screens, exploration is not done through text screens, conversations are not done through text screens, it's done in a pausible realtime. Maybe there's something that happens later, I've read a dev message that it does, but if you're only seeing something once 65.8 hours in then I'd dare say there is not enough stuff in here. 

Anyway blah blah ramble ramble the game just isn't finished. You can still have fun with it but you should consider that before deciding whether or not to buy it. It came out of early access from a 0.15 (or 0.17? can't remember) version and it shows.
items.text_zh:
真是巨大的遗憾，我超级期待这款游戏完成，但他们的最终发布状态简直荒谬。尽可能给出最清晰的总结：输入“1.0版本”实际上并不意味着某个东西现在是1.0。游戏没有完成，而且它几乎明确地告诉你它没有完成。大部分地图仍然是占位空间站，唯一完全充实和完成的区域似乎是OKLG、金星，也许还有谷神星。如果你停靠在一个空间站，弹出的文本以“也许有一天飞行员能够做的不仅仅是贸易”结尾，那就是游戏在告诉你“这不是一个完成的区域”。我的问题是，如果超过一半的空间站没有完成，这怎么算1.0发布？当你还有那么多工作要做时，你怎么从0.15版本跳到1.0？依我看，干脆把0.15称为1.0版本，然后去掉“抢先体验”标签。

AI仍然很糟糕，他们会穿着宇航服把自己呛死，如果他们手满时被自动分配去搬运东西，他们会走到物品那里然后取消任务（因为他们不知道放下手里的东西），没有区域分类来区分零件和整艘飞船部件（“我想把主板和废料这样的电子零件放在这里，但我必须选择一个类别，这也会导致船员搬运我不需要的整台电脑和电池。”）

与上述相关，人与人之间的战斗和空间站安保迫切需要更多完善。你可以通过给墙壁放气杀死整个空间站，然后直接飞走。如果安保停靠你的飞船来罚款或逮捕你，99%的情况下你可以赢得与他们的拳斗，然后装作什么都没发生。我想能解决这个问题的是给安保部队的飞船配备某种武器，但坦率地说，真正需要发生的是增加更多人员战斗内容，让不同战斗更有挑战性。安保部队有搭档，或者加入护甲物品，或者增加更多战斗动作等等。海盗行为，或者我见过的海盗行为，就是某个废物在废弃飞船上戴着黄铜指虎跳出来说“交出货物”，然后被手枪打得透不过气。就像，哈哈，什么？到目前为止，我在游戏中一次都没有在人员战斗中遇到困难。即使后面还有更多内容，我也不相信65小时还不够看到事情起色。
更新：在一个海盗更多的区域，发现了人员战斗的AI问题。敌方AI似乎不知道他们有枪械，完全不会交战。我干掉了三个持手枪的海盗，因为他们没有反击，而是一再要求我投降，同时被反复射击。当我直接站在他们面前大约五分钟时，他们甚至没有尝试使用近战。敌对登船者似乎也不明白他们是敌对登船者，不会进入我的飞船攻击我，他们只是待在自己的飞船里。另外，任何非敌对的人试图停靠你的飞船（比如你发出燃料求救信号，或者NASS巡逻队停靠进行检查/开罚单），他们进来时太猛，把飞船撞在一起，最终杀死自己。

优化很差，随机地，原因我完全不明白。游戏会进入大规模减速，或者拒绝保存，或者冻结，或者保存要花很长时间。当你在4天旅程中以最大速度火炬驱动时，如果你进入这些减速，AI也可能冻结并取消他们自己的自动命令。

游戏循环很有趣，但实现得很差。游戏实际上说你是打捞者，这在技术上是对的，也在技术上是错的。你开始时是打捞者，但随着游戏后期进展，这不再值得。至少一旦你获得火炬驱动，你需要成为太空卡车司机，打捞与货物相比的时间投入与利润激励了货物。赏金猎人在游戏中，但要做它你需要购买武器，这些武器只在某些空间站出售（这些仍然是占位符），而且它们足够远，你实际上玩几天游戏都到不了那里。65小时后，我完全没能进入飞船战斗。这是一件极其奇怪的事情，当游戏中有许多系统时，但你现实时间几天都看不到它们，并且需要去游戏未完成的部分获取参与所需的东西。

这次是个人抱怨，但我真的希望有更多恐怖/超自然/奇怪元素。有人可能会说它们存在，但很罕见，但我不同意。早期有一个重大事件，一旦解决你就不会再看到任何东西。至少，我没有看到其他任何东西。

我还没有完成主线剧情，但无论如何我在这里仍有批评。没有剧透，故事与游戏机制的交叉非常少。我只看到肉类 storyline 影响游戏。强调一下，我总共玩了95小时，发布后65.8小时，只有一个 storyline 实际引入了影响我游玩方式的东西。我理解Neo Scavenger也用文本屏幕讲故事，但这款游戏的玩法不同。战斗不是通过文本屏幕完成的，探索不是通过文本屏幕完成的，对话不是通过文本屏幕完成的，它是在可暂停的实时中完成的。也许后面会发生什么，我读过开发者消息说会，但如果你在65.8小时后才只看到一次东西，那我敢说这里内容不够。

总之 blah blah 胡扯胡扯，游戏就是没完成。你仍然可以玩得开心，但在决定是否购买之前应该考虑这一点。它从0.15（还是0.17？记不清了）版本脱离抢先体验，而且这很明显。

items.text:
[h1]6/10 - отличная основа, но контента быстро перестаёт хватать[/h1]

[b]64 часа после релиза 1.0.[/b]

[h2]Плюсы[/h2]

[b]+[/b] Очень интересное начало: постепенно разбираешься в корабле, атмосфере, энергии и вообще понимаешь, как тут выживать.

[b]+[/b] Классная система управления кораблём через консоль и навигацию. Полёты реально ощущаются как полёты.

[b]+[/b] Разбирать дереликты — одно из самых интересных занятий в игре.

[h2]Минусы[/h2]

[b]Однообразие.[/b] Улетел на другой конец Солнечной системы — а там практически та же игра. Те же предметы, корабли, технологии и занятия. Нового прогресса почти нет.

[b]− Интерфейс.[/b] Очень часто приходится догадываться, что делает та или иная кнопка. Например, я купил корабль через [b]Брокера[/b], а после покупки обнаружил, что он находится [b]в 276 млн км от меня[/b]. До покупки игра практически не объяснила, что я приобретаю корабль, который физически находится фиг знает где.

[b]− Баги.[/b] Особенно задолбала самопроизвольная пауза на K-Leg: уведомления отключены, автопауза отключена, но игра всё равно периодически ставит игру на паузу сама. Трам на Китайской станции вообще не работает.

[b]− Подработки и NPC быстро становятся скучными.[/b] Большинство заданий — «принеси X» или «поговори за меня». Очень не хватает нормальных цепочек заданий и событий.

[b]− Сюжетные крючки не всегда имеют отдачу.[/b] Например, я сам поставил себе целью найти родителей персонажа и ради этого полетел через станции. В итоге добрался до мамы — и практически ничего интересного не произошло.

[h2]Итог[/h2]

[b]6/10.[/b]

Атмосфера и основа игры отличные, первые десятки часов реально затягивают. Но потом понимаешь, что [b]огромный мир пока наполнен слишком однообразным контентом[/b].

Потенциал у игры огромный, через годик может моддеры и разрабы игру допилят. Игру рекомендую сейчас, пока цена адекватная. Свои 50 часов вы получите кайфа а потом вам надоест.
items.text_zh:
[h1]6/10 - 出色的基础，但内容很快就变得不够用[/h1]

[b]1.0发布后64小时。[/b]

[h2]优点[/h2]

[b]+[/b] 非常有趣的开局：你会逐渐搞懂飞船、大气、能量，并总体上明白如何在这里生存。

[b]+[/b] 通过控制台和导航来操控飞船的系统很棒。飞行真的感觉像在飞行。

[b]+[/b] 拆解废弃飞船是游戏里最有趣的活动之一。

[h2]缺点[/h2]

[b]单调。[/b] 飞到太阳系的另一端——那里几乎是同样的游戏。同样的物品、飞船、科技和活动。几乎没有新的进展。

[b]− 界面。[/b] 经常得靠猜某个按钮是干什么的。比如，我通过[b]经纪人[/b]买了一艘飞船，买完之后才发现它[b]离我有2.76亿公里[/b]。购买之前，游戏几乎没有解释我买的是一艘物理上位于鬼知道哪里的飞船。

[b]− Bug。[/b] 尤其烦人的是K-Leg上的自动暂停：通知关了，自动暂停也关了，但游戏还是会时不时自己把游戏暂停。中国空间站上的电车根本不工作。

[b]− 兼职和NPC很快就变得无聊。[/b] 大多数任务都是“把X带来”或“替我说话”。非常缺少像样的任务链和事件。

[b]− 剧情钩子并不总是有回报。[/b] 比如，我自己把找到角色父母设为目标，为此穿过一个个空间站。结果找到了妈妈——却几乎没发生什么有趣的事。

[h2]总结[/h2]

[b]6/10。[/b]

氛围和游戏基础都很出色，最初几十小时确实很吸引人。但之后你会明白，[b]这个庞大的世界目前填充的内容还是太单调了[/b]。

这游戏的潜力巨大，也许一年后模组作者和开发者会把它打磨好。现在价格还算合理，我推荐这款游戏。你能获得大约50小时的乐趣，然后就会腻了。

items.text:
TLDR: Calling this a 1.0 release is like pointing at a cow and calling it a steak. 

Ostranauts would be my absolute dream game......  if it was actually finished.
I deeply love the idea here, thats why i played it for so long....  But oh man, i had to fight the game at every turn for my fun. 

Rarely have i ever seen a game that is soo buggy, soo glitchy, soo poorly optimized, so critically falwed in many of its systems and controlls.... and yet so engaging(over 100 hours speak for themselves).

All of this would be(and for someone with my tastes veary much is) fine...... for an early acess game... for an alpha. But calling whats on offer here 1.0 is a crime and deeply dissapointing. Especially because the game clearly is someones passion project and anything but a cashgrab.. 

Dont, under no circumstances buy this, unless you are willing to play a broken alpha that (considering the full release) will likely never get adequately finished or even fixed.




Here a List of issues i encountered, this list is by no means exhaustive....  

Buggy Npcs: (i looted soo many EVA suits from random pedestrians walking out the airlock without a helmet)

Buggy Task system: (every tasks is performed 1 by one, from bottom screen to top screen with no regard to distance or required items, my character must easily get in 30000 steps a day in the small cramped ship)

Buggy Life support: compressing gas from a room into a can and than releasing it again magically cools it to -273°C for some reason which in turn reduces its pressure.. making it increadibly hard for heaters to heat it up again...

Missing automation: there is a "signal box" item in the game that even teases us with settings for logical functions... hovever it cant recieve inputs from any other device, so in effect its just a needlessly complicated powerswitch. 

Missing device functionality in general (you cant even customize the "to hot/To cold" threshholds at the thermostat)

Insufficient controll settings in general: not being able to selectively set power levels for directional and rotational thrust is fine in the beginning when everything is super slow, but man does it suck when you pilot your 50 ton custom freighter through the venusian atmosphere and the shortest of cklicks for a tiny course correction sends you spinning to your death becaus you did not revert to 1x speed on your flight that takes 5 real time minutes even on 16x speed. 

Lack of systems variety... the only system that has a direct upgraded version (besides the diffrently sized batteries and the turbo pumps) is the kang rcs intake wich is surpassed by the pricier/rarer hydra. There is 0 variety in regards to thrusters, reactor parts, nav consoles, beds, sensors, tanks..   no upgrades, no sidegrades....  just more of the same old boring stuff. 

Orbital mechanics ar major BS: How come, that when i fly right up to the venusian orbital station and i perfectly align my orbit to it (with the provided match speed setting) it rapidly acellerates away from me the moment i disable the setting? we share the exact same orbit, it should at best drift very slowly towards or away from me. Does it not like me? does it use its thrusters to boost away from me?  

Also, if you want us to engage with orbital mechanics, at least give us a propper maneuver palnner Kerbal space programm came out 11 years ago ffs.
items.text_zh:
TLDR：把这称为1.0正式版，就像指着一头牛说它是牛排。

Ostranauts本会是我绝对的梦想游戏……如果它真的完成了的话。
我深深喜爱这里的构想，这就是为什么我玩了这么久……但天哪，我为了获得乐趣，不得不时时刻刻跟这游戏搏斗。

我很少见到一款游戏如此充满bug、如此故障频出、优化如此糟糕、许多系统和操控存在如此关键的缺陷……却又如此引人入胜（超过100小时本身就说明问题）。

所有这些本来会（而且对于像我这种口味的人来说确实非常）没问题……对于一款抢先体验游戏……对于一款alpha版来说。但把这里提供的东西称为1.0版是一种犯罪，而且令人深感失望。尤其是因为这款游戏显然是某人的热情项目，绝不是圈钱之作。

不要，在任何情况下都不要买这个，除非你愿意玩一个破碎的alpha版，而且（考虑到正式发行）它很可能永远得不到充分的完成，甚至修复。




以下是我遇到的一堆问题，这份清单绝非详尽无遗……

有bug的NPC：（我从随机行人那里捡了太多EVA服，他们不戴头盔就走出了气闸）

有bug的任务系统：（每个任务都一个接一个地执行，从屏幕底部到屏幕顶部，完全不考虑距离或所需物品，我的角色在这艘狭小拥挤的飞船里每天轻松走30000步）

有bug的生命维持系统：把房间里的气体压缩进罐子，然后再释放出来，不知为何会神奇地冷却到-273°C，这反过来又降低了它的压力……让加热器极难把它重新加热……

缺失的自动化：游戏里有一个“信号盒”物品，甚至用逻辑功能设置来挑逗我们……然而它无法接收任何其他设备的输入，所以实际上它只是一个没必要地复杂的电源开关。

总体上缺失的设备功能（你甚至无法在恒温器上自定义“太热/太冷”的阈值）

总体上不足的控制设置：在一切超级缓慢的开局阶段，无法为方向推进和旋转推进选择性地设置功率级别还算可以，但天哪，当你驾驶50吨的定制货船穿过金星大气层时，为了微小的航向修正而进行的最短点击都会让你旋转着送命，因为你在一次即使16倍速也要花5分钟真实时间的飞行中没有切回1倍速。

缺乏系统多样性……唯一有直接升级版本的系统（除了不同尺寸的电池和涡轮泵）是kang RCS进气口，它被更贵/更稀有的hydra超越。在推进器、反应堆部件、导航控制台、床、传感器、储罐方面有0多样性……没有升级，没有横向替换……只是更多同样无聊的老东西。

轨道力学完全是胡扯：为什么当我飞到金星轨道站正旁边，并（用提供的匹配速度设置）完美地将我的轨道与它对齐时，我一禁用该设置，它就迅速加速远离我？我们共享完全相同的轨道，它最多应该非常缓慢地朝我漂来或漂离。它不喜欢我吗？它用推进器加速远离我吗？

另外，如果你想让我们接触轨道力学，至少给我们一个像样的机动规划器，Kerbal太空计划11年前就出了，靠。

items.text: I really, really wanted to like this game. The initial gameplay loop of exploring wrecks and pulling the copper out of the walls is really fun. I have no idea why they didn't just lean into making that the whole game when they weren't willing to clean up the rest of it. NPC communication is clunky and pointless. The Jobs are very lackluster, they're all just travel somewhere or beat up someone and deal with the inability to keep a prisoner. Survival is trivial. You can live in your EVA suit at the cost of burning through more water and downtime so why bother pressurizing your vessel at all until you're rich and well fed enough for it not to matter and the rewards from one early game salvage run will keep you fed in high quality food for the rest of the game. It's still riddled with bugs, poor communication of mechanics, and has little to do once you get you first ship remodeled and running. This has the skeleton to be an outstanding title, but it would require such a hard pivot from the direction the game has been going in that I don't think it'll ever manifest. The majority of my time was spent repeating the first 10 hours over and over due to constantly have to restart from gamebreaking errors or from being on fast forward and my guy walked outside without his helmet for the fun of it.
items.text_zh: 我真的、真的非常想喜欢这款游戏。最初探索残骸、从墙壁里拽出铜的游戏循环真的很有趣。我不明白为什么他们不愿意把其余部分收拾干净，却不肯干脆把这一点做成整个游戏。NPC交流既笨拙又毫无意义。任务非常乏味，全都只是去某个地方或者揍某个人，还要应付无法关押囚犯的问题。生存要素微不足道。你可以靠你的EVA服活着，代价只是消耗更多水和停机时间，所以在你足够富有、吃得够饱，以至于这些都无所谓之前，何必费心给自己的飞船加压呢？而且早期一次打捞任务的奖励就能让你在游戏剩下的时间里一直吃上高质量食物。它仍然满是bug，机制说明糟糕，而且当你把第一艘船改装好并运转起来后，就几乎没什么可做的了。它具备成为一款杰出作品的骨架，但这需要从游戏一直以来的方向上进行如此艰难的转向，我觉得它永远不会实现。我的大部分时间都花在反复重复最初的10个小时上，因为不断得从破坏游戏的错误中重启，或者因为开着快进而我的角色为了好玩没戴头盔就走到了外面。

items.text: Came back to the game for the 1.0 launch, and I've been enjoying it. As others have noted, there are concerning bugs, but I've not encountered too many. I'm playing without any additional crew, as I've heard they can lead to performance and other issues. The core experience of scavenging ships in space has been slow but pretty fun, and I'm eager to try some of the other stuff available in-game. The character creator could definitely use some work, but I'd recommend engaging with it to ensure you play a good character if you plan on making a long run--age and injury in particular are worth avoiding.
items.text_zh: 为了1.0发布回归了这款游戏，我一直玩得很开心。正如其他人所指出的，有一些令人担忧的bug，但我没遇到太多。我在没有任何额外船员的情况下游玩，因为我听说他们可能导致性能和其他问题。在太空中打捞飞船的核心体验一直很慢，但相当有趣，我渴望尝试游戏内可用的其他一些内容。角色创建器肯定还需要一些改进，但如果你打算进行长期游玩，我建议你认真对待它，以确保你扮演一个好角色——尤其是年龄和伤病值得避免。

items.text:
Coming as someone who ONLY played this after the 1.0 release - 

An amazing, great game. One of the best of all time maybe.
But only If you can tolerate the janky UI and total lack of documentation on what is actually a feature of the game, and what isn't.

So, why do I love it so much? Well, it's the most immersive spaceship game I've ever played. It's not just about piloting the spaceships - it's about living a simulated life *as* a spaceship captain. 

In this game, everyone, including you, needs to sleep somewhere, drink, eat, use the toilet, and socialize.

I've visited bars on the space station just to chat and flirt with random people in order to address my psychological needs. I've used coffee as a replacement for sleep, and suffered the consequences. I've engaged in idle chitchat with someone with the intention of pivoting to the subject of hiring them as crew - and succeeded. 

I've spent hours alone working on my ship, sending my needs for achievement, privacy, and security to the best they can possibly be, while my needs for socialization, belonging and intimacy tanked.

I've left the helm unattended, risking colliding with something just to get a few extra minutes of repairs in before I need to take control again. 

I've shut off alarms because they annoyed me, only to die because I forgot they were off and I didn't get the warning in time.

I've accidently left my air pumps on and didn't notice my ship was pressurized to ~50 times earth atmosphere until I started hearing metal creaking from the fusion fuel tanks inside my ship being crushed.

I've been pressed into my pilot seat by gforces from accelerating. I've had crew members fall over while they were working when I did a sudden maneuver.

I've died to fires in my ship, and I've had my life saved by my CO2 alarm going off while I was piloting. I've vented the entire cabin into space to get rid of the smoke and co2, and lived to tell about it. I've fled into the space station from a fire on my ship while docked, only to die of heat stroke, burns, and inhalation of smoke and co2.

I've accidently walked into space without a sealed suit too many times to count, and usually lived. One time I did so while working on my ship in dock, and barely made it into the pressurized station - at the end I was moving at a snails pace, on the verge of blacking out, body pressed to the absolute limits. A minute or so of rest, and I went back to work on my ship, now a little smarter.

I've subdued or killed pirates with my fists, a tactical knife, a 9mm pistol, and a katana. I've had pirates panic after shooting at them several times, even though I didn't hit them. I've sold a colt 1911 I found on a junked ship because I have no idea where to buy .45 ammo in this backwater I'm stuck on. I sold a cutlass I found because who needs one when they already have a katana.

I finally assembled a fusion reactor, and figured out how to start it. I also made a small mistake and seriously wore it out and almost exploded it. I reloaded a save game to avoid having to find a new one that hadn't been taken to the verge of ruin by a stupid newbie. Then I figured out what I did wrong, and successfully started and used the reactor without damaging it.

I've been putting things like bedrooms, bathrooms, and exercise rooms in my ship - in preparation for my first journey from this junkyard rock in the middle of nowhere, to an actual place like the cloud cities of Venus, affluent Mars, the moon (which I've been told is haunted) or the United States Military Industrial Complex, located on the moon Titan. Just some of the examples of places I could go, from The Sun, out to the Oort cloud. 81 hours in and I've barely scratched the surface!


So what's bad? Mostly the UI. 

The UI works, it tells you what you need to know, and lets you do what you need to do - but you will need to spend maybe 20 hours figuring out just the basics of what the f it's telling you, and how the f you do the things.

For the first 10-20 hours playing, if you're like me you're going to be asking yourself WTF did that just happen (haven't learned how to read the UI yet, don't know what's possible within the game),

Why did my character/this NPC do this stupid fatal thing (probably because I told it to do that stupid thing, or it wasn't actually stupid).

Why does this ship part work in this stupid way (it probably doesn't work that way, or the way it works is actually not stupid). 

Why do I have to micromanage everything all of the time! (don't have to micromanage everything all of the time, but learning how to use the install planning / orders system and the tasks system is a whole new learning experience compared to directly controlling your character).

That was my experience anyway. 

Finally, bugs. As near as I can tell everything important in the game works fine, which I consider a miracle given the scope of the game. So I don't know what all the "this game is buggy and unplayable!" people are talking about. 
 
That being said, I have experienced the following 6 things that I believe are bugs:

1. The one system I've encountered that seems flat out bugged and not working seems to be pirates surrendering - the game seems to imply I can give a surrendered pirate orders or take control of them somehow, but I've never had any control whatsoever over them. Can't even ask them to drop their weapon, frisk them, or restrain them. They do stop attacking for a while, but that's it.

2. Speaking of dumb pirates, sometimes when a pirate jumps me and docks to my vessel - instead of actually boarding me they just stay on their ship and do random tasks. Also it seems like I can just undock from forced docking? I've yet to have permission to undock refused. Seems like a bug?

3. I've also had occasional stuttering that sucks but is still playable - it seems to happen after a while playing, and goes away after quitting and reloading. 

[strike]4. The game hasn't crashed on me yet, but it does hang when I quit the game more often than not, and I have to force close. Annoying, but not game breaking in any way.[/strike] Fixed by a post release patch.

5. Sometimes the character interaction leaves me hanging at "waiting for the other person to respond". But this is relatively rare/situational and seems to resolve itself eventually. Unfortunate and I hope they fix it, but again - not unplayable.

6. Last bad thing - sometimes NPC ships ignore the speed of their ship and the limits of the human body. I didn't see this happen until relatively recently when a pirate jumped my extremely fast ship. I dodged them, outran them, out accelerated them - but then, they went from rapidly falling behind me to surging into me in an amount of time that would have turned them into goo. After killing them I observed that their ship wasn't that fast either. Devs, this sucks - please fix it.


So overall? This game has been amazing. Not broken, not unplayable. Just has a really high UI learning curve, a few non fatal technical issues, and some unfortunate bugs. Maybe all the game breaking stuff happens after the 81 hour mark?
items.text_zh:
作为一个只在1.0发布后才开始玩这款游戏的人——

一款令人惊叹的、伟大的游戏。也许是有史以来最好的游戏之一。
但前提是你能够忍受那蹩脚的UI，以及完全没有文档说明游戏中哪些是真正的功能、哪些不是。

那么，我为什么这么喜欢它呢？嗯，这是我玩过的最具沉浸感的太空飞船游戏。它不仅仅是驾驶太空飞船——而是*作为*一名太空飞船船长过着模拟生活。

在这款游戏中，每个人，包括你自己，都需要找个地方睡觉、喝水、吃饭、上厕所、社交。

我去过空间站上的酒吧，只是为了和随机的人聊天、调情，以满足我的心理需求。我用咖啡代替睡眠，并承受了后果。我和某人闲聊，意图把话题转向雇佣他们作为船员——而且成功了。

我独自花了几个小时在飞船上工作，把我的成就、隐私和安全需求提升到尽可能最好的状态，而我的社交、归属感和亲密需求却一落千丈。

我让舵位无人看管，冒着撞上什么东西的风险，只为在我需要重新掌控之前多挤出几分钟的修理时间。

我关掉了警报，因为它们烦我，结果却因为忘了它们关着、没能及时收到警告而死。

我不小心让空气泵一直开着，直到我开始听到飞船内部聚变燃料箱被压碎时金属发出的嘎吱声，才注意到飞船被加压到了约50倍地球大气压。

我被加速产生的G力压在驾驶座上。当我突然机动时，有船员在工作时摔倒。

我死于飞船上的火灾，也曾在驾驶时因二氧化碳警报响起而获救。我曾把整个舱室排空到太空中以清除烟雾和二氧化碳，并活了下来讲述这件事。我曾因停靠时飞船上的火灾而逃进空间站，结果却死于热射病、烧伤以及吸入烟雾和二氧化碳。

我不小心没穿密封服就走入太空的次数多到数不清，而且通常都活了下来。有一次我在船坞里修理飞船时这么做了，勉强进入了加压的空间站——最后我以蜗牛般的速度移动，濒临昏厥，身体被逼到了绝对极限。休息了一分钟左右，我又回去修理飞船，现在稍微聪明了一点。

我用拳头、战术刀、9毫米手枪和武士刀制服或杀死了海盗。我曾让海盗在朝他们开了几枪后惊慌失措，尽管我并没有打中他们。我卖掉了一艘废弃飞船上找到的柯尔特1911，因为我完全不知道在这个我困守的穷乡僻壤哪里能买到.45弹药。我卖掉了一把找到的弯刀，因为已经有武士刀了谁还需要它呢。

我终于组装好了一个聚变反应堆，并弄清楚了如何启动它。我也犯了一个小错误，严重磨损了它，差点把它弄爆炸。我重新加载了一个存档，以避免不得不去找一个新的、还没被某个愚蠢新手折腾到濒临报废的反应堆。然后我弄明白了自己做错了什么，并成功启动和使用了反应堆而没有损坏它。

我一直在往飞船里放卧室、浴室和健身房之类的东西——为我的第一次旅程做准备，从这个位于荒无人烟之地的废品场岩石，前往一个真正的地方，比如金星的云城、富裕的火星、月球（有人告诉我那里闹鬼）或者位于土星泰坦上的美国军工联合体。这些只是我能去的地方的一些例子，从太阳一直延伸到奥尔特云。玩了81个小时，我几乎还没触及皮毛！


那么有什么不好的呢？主要是UI。

UI能用，它会告诉你需要知道的东西，让你做需要做的事——但你可能需要花大约20个小时才能弄清楚它到底在说什么鬼东西，以及你到底该怎么做这些事。

在玩的前10到20个小时里，如果你像我一样，你会问自己这到底发生了什么（还没学会怎么看UI，不知道游戏里什么是可能的），

为什么我的角色/这个NPC做了这件愚蠢的致命事情（可能是因为我叫它做了那件蠢事，或者它其实并不蠢）。

为什么这个飞船部件以这种愚蠢的方式工作（它可能不是那样工作的，或者它的工作方式其实并不蠢）。

为什么我时时刻刻都得微观管理一切！（不必时时刻刻微观管理一切，但学习如何使用安装规划/命令系统和任务系统，与直接控制你的角色相比，是一种全新的学习体验）。

反正这就是我的经历。

最后，bug。据我所知，游戏中所有重要的东西都运行良好，考虑到游戏的规模，我认为这是个奇迹。所以我不知道那些说“这游戏bug多到没法玩！”的人在说什么。

话虽如此，我遇到过以下6件我认为是bug的事情：

1. 我遇到的唯一一个似乎彻底出bug、无法正常运作的系统，似乎是海盗投降——游戏似乎暗示我可以给投降的海盗下命令或以某种方式控制他们，但我从来没能对他们有任何控制权。甚至不能叫他们放下武器、搜身或捆绑他们。他们确实会停止攻击一段时间，但仅此而已。

2. 说到愚蠢的海盗，有时当海盗跳到我船上并停靠到我的飞船时——他们并不真正登船，而是待在自己的船上做随机任务。而且似乎我可以直接从强制停靠中脱离？我还没有被拒绝过脱离许可。看起来像个bug？

3. 我偶尔也会遇到卡顿，很烦但还能玩——似乎玩了一段时间后会出现，退出并重新加载后就消失了。

[删除线]4. 游戏还没有在我这里崩溃过，但退出游戏时它经常卡住，我不得不强制关闭。烦人，但绝不至于破坏游戏体验。[/删除线]已由发布后补丁修复。

5. 有时角色互动会让我卡在“等待对方回应”。但这相对罕见/视情况而定，而且似乎最终会自行解决。很不幸，我希望他们能修复它，但再次强调——并非无法游玩。

6. 最后一件坏事——有时NPC飞船会无视自己飞船的速度和人体极限。我直到最近才看到这种情况发生，当时一艘海盗船跳到了我极快的飞船上。我躲开了他们，跑赢了他们，加速超过了他们——但随后，他们在本应把他们变成糊状的时间内，从迅速落后于我变成猛冲撞向我。杀死他们后，我观察到他们的飞船其实也没那么快。开发者们，这很糟糕——请修复它。


所以总体而言？这款游戏一直很棒。没有坏掉，并非无法游玩。只是UI学习曲线非常高，有一些非致命的技术问题，以及一些不幸的bug。也许所有破坏游戏的东西都发生在81小时之后？
（有人告诉我那里闹鬼）或者位于土卫六上的美国军工复合体。这些只是我能去的地方的一些例子，从太阳，一直到奥尔特云。玩了81个小时，我才刚刚触及皮毛！


那么有什么不好的？主要是UI。

UI能用，它会告诉你需要知道的东西，让你做你需要做的事——但你可能需要花大约20个小时才能搞明白它到底在说什么鬼东西，以及你到底该怎么做事。

在游戏的前10-20个小时里，如果你像我一样，你会问自己这到底刚刚发生了什么（还没学会怎么看UI，不知道游戏里能做什么），

为什么我的角色/这个NPC做了这种愚蠢的致命事情（可能是因为我叫它做了那件蠢事，或者那件事其实并不蠢）。

为什么这个飞船部件以这种愚蠢的方式工作（它可能不是那样工作的，或者它的工作方式其实并不蠢）。

为什么我时时刻刻都得微观管理一切！（不必时时刻刻微观管理一切，但学习如何使用安装规划/命令系统和任务系统，与直接控制你的角色相比，是一种全新的学习体验）。

反正这就是我的经历。

最后，bug。据我所知，游戏里所有重要的东西都运行良好，考虑到游戏的规模，我认为这是个奇迹。所以我不知道那些说“这游戏bug多到没法玩！”的人到底在说什么。

话虽如此，我遇到过以下6件我认为是bug的事情：

1. 我遇到的唯一一个似乎彻底有bug、无法正常运作的系统，似乎是海盗投降——游戏似乎暗示我可以给投降的海盗下命令，或者以某种方式控制他们，但我从来没能对他们有任何控制权。甚至不能叫他们放下武器、搜身或制服他们。他们确实会停止攻击一段时间，但也就仅此而已。

2. 说到愚蠢的海盗，有时候海盗跳到我船上并对接我的飞船时——他们并不实际登船，而是待在自己的船上做随机任务。而且似乎我可以直接从强制对接中脱离对接？我还没有遇到过不允许脱离对接的情况。看起来像是个bug？

3. 我偶尔还会遇到卡顿，很烦，但仍然能玩——似乎是在玩了一段时间后出现，退出并重新加载后就消失了。

[strike]4. 游戏还没有在我这里崩溃过，但在我退出游戏时，它多半会卡住，我不得不强制关闭。很烦，但无论如何都不算破坏游戏体验。[/strike] 已由发布后补丁修复。

5. 有时候角色互动会让我卡在“等待对方回应”。但这相对罕见/视情况而定，而且似乎最终会自行解决。很不幸，我希望他们能修复它，但再说一次——不是没法玩。

6. 最后一件坏事——有时候NPC飞船会无视自己飞船的速度和人类身体的极限。我直到最近才看到这种情况发生，当时一艘海盗船跳到了我那艘极快的飞船上。我躲开了他们，跑赢了他们，加速度也超过了他们——但随后，他们从迅速落在我后面，变成在短时间内猛冲撞向我，那种加速度本会把它们变成一滩烂泥。杀了他们之后，我观察到他们的飞船其实也没那么快。开发者们，这很糟糕——请修复它。


所以总体而言？这款游戏一直很棒。没有坏掉，不是没法玩。只是UI学习曲线真的很高
曲线，一些非致命的技术问题，以及一些不幸的bug。也许所有破坏游戏的东西都发生在81小时之后？

items.text:
The game's engine creaks beneath its own weight, but the concept is compelling - space is big and uncaring, you are small and prone to dying due to hypoxia, and the game will do its best to simulate everything surrounding the two meeting. Salvage has its excitement and shipbuilding's results are undeniably satisfying, even if the process is agonizingly clunky. Given the game's promise I had been quite content to patiently watch it slowly develop as the years rolled by. Some day the AI would no longer be a narcoleptic mess, the UI would no longer be the biggest adversary, and the game would, y'know, [i]work[/i]. No more crashes or grinding lag from one of a dozen different things breaking in the background.

Then I got the announcement that the game had hit 1.0 and full release! 🚀 Waow, exciting!

I [i]broke into laughter[/i] at the absurdity of it. I have no idea what must have possessed Blue Bottle to release if not desperation, but if so they're certainly not copping to it. From the patchnotes released today: "[b]While we figured there would be [i]some[/i] pain points revealed with launch, I think we significantly underestimated just how many there were.[/b]" Given I knew that full-well as a simple player, I cannot fathom how the game's developers could be surprised. Rather, it reads to me as 'sorry you're so mad,' and the gall of it is part of what motivated me to write up this review in the first place.

The game's release as what purports to be a full 1.0 product is disingenuous at best, and gives me great pause with respect to the odds of the continued support of the game and its prospect of ever [i]actually[/i] being finished, rather than remaining a janky mess. I'm still content to wait the years I think it will take to get it there, but I'm no longer confident that will come to pass. New players should know what to expect when buying in, and it is definitively [i]not[/i] a finished, polished experience.
items.text_zh:
这游戏的引擎在自己重压下吱嘎作响，但概念很吸引人——太空浩瀚而冷漠，你渺小且容易因缺氧而死，游戏会尽力模拟两者相遇时周围的一切。打捞有其刺激感，造船的成果无可否认地令人满足，即便过程笨拙得令人痛苦。鉴于游戏的承诺，多年来我一直很满足于耐心地看着它慢慢开发。总有一天，AI 不会再是一团嗜睡症般的烂摊子，UI 不会再是最大的对手，游戏会，你懂的，[i]正常运作[/i]。不再有崩溃，也不再有后台十几个东西中某一个坏掉导致的卡顿延迟。

然后我看到了游戏达到 1.0 正式发布的公告！🚀 哇，真令人兴奋！

我[i]笑出了声[/i]，因为这事太荒谬了。我不知道是什么驱使 Blue Bottle 发布，如果不是绝望的话，但如果是的话，他们肯定不会承认。从今天发布的补丁说明来看：“[b]虽然我们料到发布时会暴露出[i]一些[/i]痛点，但我认为我们严重低估了痛点的数量。[/b]”既然我作为一个普通玩家都对此心知肚明，我无法理解游戏开发者怎么会感到惊讶。相反，在我看来这读起来像是‘抱歉你这么生气’，而其中的厚颜无耻正是促使我写下这篇评测的部分原因。

游戏以号称完整 1.0 产品的形式发布，往好了说是虚伪，往坏了说让我对游戏持续支持的可能性以及它是否[i]真正[/i]能完成、而不是继续一团糟的前景深感疑虑。我仍然愿意等待我认为需要数年才能达到那一步，但我不再确信那会实现。新玩家在购买时应该知道会面临什么，而这绝对[i]不是[/i]一次完成、打磨过的体验。

items.text:
I can build as many fusion reactors as i want, Amanda. Thank you very much.

I walked around in early access and it was a little too rough for me, with 1.0 i got a little disappointed that even some widely known bugs like being permanently barefoot and needing to debug it out were still present or came back to life on release. But the devs are awesome and hard at work and already patched most of them. The simulating is quite wild so some wonky stuff is just part of it. 

The patch has ended this but, It was very fun watching multiple random criminal npc's spawn and beat armed law enforcement officers into the ground by dual wielding briefcases. On my 3rd in game hour this one non-binary officer shot through her colleague to finally put the stations "public enemy" down (they resisted arrest while unarmed). I felt bad for the law enforcer bleeding out on the ground but couldn't figure out how to administer medicine so i just dragged him to a bed. He survived despite his EVA suit evaporating. 

I later got tracked down by a pirate for 200km, I called SOS for approaching threat twice in between drastic course correction to avoid being boarded by the pirate. When the police i called finally arrived to my rescue, the pirate was unconscious in my ship after putting me in a self defense situation. The same officer I dragged to a bed so he wouldn't bleed out in front of the scrap seller kiosk, that same guy, showed up in his underwear and a wifebeater to shake me down for 28 grand after asking me twice if i knew why he was boarding my ship. "I don't even care to find a reason to fine you. You are being fined!" Said Tobey Stuart, a pillar of the community in between nano therapy sessions for brain damage and anger issues. 

Really like building stuff in this. So much free real state.
items.text_zh:
我想造多少聚变反应堆就能造多少，Amanda。非常感谢。

我在抢先体验阶段四处走动过，对我来说有点太粗糙了，到了1.0我有点失望，因为即使是一些广为人知的bug，比如永久赤脚并且需要调试才能解决，在发布时仍然存在或者又复活了。但开发者们很棒，正在努力工作，已经修补了其中大部分。模拟相当狂野，所以一些古怪的东西就是它的一部分。

补丁已经结束了这个，但看着多个随机犯罪NPC生成并用双持公文包把武装执法人员打倒在地非常有趣。在我游戏内的第3个小时，这名非二元性别警官射穿了她同事的身体，终于把空间站的“公敌”放倒了（他们在手无寸铁的情况下拒捕）。我为那个流血倒地执法人员感到难过，但搞不懂怎么给药，所以我就把他拖到床上。尽管他的EVA服蒸发了，他还是活了下来。

后来我被一个海盗追踪了200公里，我在两次大幅改变航向以避免被海盗登船之间，两次呼叫SOS报告有威胁逼近。当我叫来的警察终于赶到救我时，海盗已经在我船上昏迷了，因为让我陷入了自卫局面。就是那个我拖到床上以免他在废料商亭前流血而死的警官，同一个人，穿着内裤和背心出现，在问了我两次是否知道他为什么登我的船之后，向我敲诈2万8千块。“我甚至懒得找个理由罚你。你正在被罚款！”Tobey Stuart说道，这位社区支柱在因脑损伤和愤怒问题接受纳米治疗之间。

真的很喜欢在这里建造东西。这么多免费房地产。

それと寄港している際に一般NPCが勝手に乗船して冷蔵庫開けて食糧盗み食いしたり水飲んだりしてくる

各种说明不足的UI

比如空调UI
设置好气泵和氧气罐并调成自动，应该就能很好地运作吧
→不运作？？？为什么？？？

犯罪时会被无限要求罚款，甚至变成死档，这是不是因为日语化MOD太旧了？
所以有必要好好购买许可证，注意进行合法活动

还有，停靠时普通NPC会擅自上船，打开冰箱偷吃食物或喝水
大概是因为地图上物资没有所有权概念，被当作公共共有物偷走
作为对策，锁门就好，但可能是朝向的问题，明明想从内侧上锁，却会先跑到外侧才开始上锁处理，导致无法从内侧上锁，有这种bug行为

有趣的地方也很多，但这类细小故障和不便，也属于味道和怪癖很强、能容许的人才适合

如果想更轻松地玩太空拾荒的轻度玩家，我觉得去玩《Space Haven》之类的会更满足

items.text:
I've been tentatively following this game's development since the day it was announced, but there's a good reason I waited to sink my teeth in until now. Unfortunately, I also picked a horrible time- as by the time 1.0 has dropped, the game is still riddled with bugs.

At first, they were few and far between- enough so that I was genuinely confused over all the negative reviews citing the buggy state of the game as their reason for not recommending it- but now that I've been playing a single character for an extended period of time, they've only grown more pervasive and annoying as time goes on.

The developer, Blue Bottle Games- has taken a pretty "Meh" approach to the whole thing. Player concerns have been very VERY selectively answered, and even then- the response tends to me something along the line of "Yeah here's all the reasons it wasn't ready for 1.0 but if you guys buy enough copies I might actually do something."

Overall, it's an incredibly unique game mired by a lack of commitment. I don't care if you've been working on the game for 6 years or more- you've been getting PAID to do so by people who chose to support you and your project, and they've been rewarded with a handful of dirt to the face as a thanks.
items.text_zh:
从这款游戏公布那天起，我就一直试探性地关注它的开发，但我等到现在才真正深入玩，是有充分理由的。不幸的是，我还挑了个糟糕透顶的时机——因为到1.0发布时，游戏仍然满是bug。

起初，它们很少而且间隔很长——长到我真的对那些以游戏bug多作为不推荐理由的负面评测感到困惑——但现在，在我长时间玩同一个角色之后，随着时间推移，它们只会变得越来越普遍、越来越烦人。

开发者Blue Bottle Games对整个事情采取了一种相当“一般般”的态度。玩家关切被非常非常选择性地回应，即便如此——回应往往也像是“是啊，这些就是它还没准备好1.0的所有原因，但如果你们买够多份，我可能真的会做点什么。”

总的来说，这是一款极其独特的游戏，却被缺乏承诺所拖累。我不在乎你已经做这款游戏6年还是更久——你一直因此拿到报酬，是那些选择支持你和你的项目的人付的钱，而他们得到的感谢，就是一把糊到脸上的土。
