items.text:
Ostranauts is a top down 2d space scavenger game with ship building mechanics and a simple atmosphere and orbital dynamics simulator. It also looks like there is the intent to have heat simulation and some crew interaction simulation. There is a hypothetical long range travel,  but its bugged out of any usefulness and despite dozens of attempts I failed to make the autopilot get me anywhere near anywhere else. Note that you have to use the autopilot as you cannot manually use the long range drive. That the characters die unless you manually feed them every few hours also make long distance travel atrociously annoying. It would be so simple to have them auto consume food, water and sleep when fast forwarding, but instead they just randomly die. 

and cant really say anything about it. The main game loop consists of scavenging various derelicts and building up your ship, and paying of the loans you have on the starting ship, avoiding spending too much on fuel and oxygen. This aspect is somewhat fun, but the main difficulty of the game is essentially remembering where you stored something. This makes building and repair with spare parts tedious. It would be a good idea to keep track of only a few kinds of mechanically different floors, and keep the texture of the floor separate from the type, and the same holds for walls. The shipbuilding is fun but due to storage mechanics rather tedious. The power mechanics are very opaque and there is no way to see how much something will draw. There is a system for character progression, well maybe, it still levels up the skills you already have, and when they finally reach 100% you never get anything for it, but it does look like its there... The amount of work needed is also wildly varying and disproportionate. Combat and conversation is lousy, again mostly due to bad ui. It would be better if you entered into a  different kind of menu for it, rather than needing to scroll around and guess what things do. 

There should also be difficulty related to managing food, drink and atmosphere and heat, but these systems are nearly trivial to maintain, or bugged. There is also no recycling of food drink wast etc, no greenhouses, and strangely no solar panels or radio isotope generators. The occasional loss of power, or fuel, or crashing nav station are all fun things mini events but can be a bit too punishing in some cases. 

There is an interesting character creation process, but its rather limited, and without knowing what anything does its less fun. 

The problem is the bugs. Bugs like your character equiping a space helmet for no clear reason and then falling unconsious once the air runs out while inside your ship where the atmosphere is fine. Bugs like the various character status bars being difficult to intrepet, or again bugged. Bugs like not needing to go to the bathroom for months before suddenly nearly dying due to not having been in the last few minutes over and over again. Bugs like station personel dropping like flies if you stick around for a few hours, leaving their valuables behind.  Bugs like losing the ability to left click on things, which is the main mode of interaction, bugs like the character randomly committing suicide in various ways. The game is also astonishingly slow to load and save which is the only way to fix most bugs. Please upgrade to protobufs with an arena and stop using zipped jsons... Also the game badly needs longer range for a* when searching for valid paths and valid haul locations. 

The game is really promising, but just not ready for release yet. If you are willing to live with alot of unintuitive ui, jank the game is fun as is, but it still needs alot of work.
items.text_zh:
《Ostranauts》是一款俯视视角的2D太空打捞游戏，带有飞船建造机制，以及一个简单的大气与轨道动力学模拟器。看起来它还打算加入热量模拟和一些船员互动模拟。游戏里有一种假想中的远距离航行，但它已经bug到毫无用处，尽管我尝试了几十次，还是没能让自动驾驶把我带到任何其他地方附近。注意，你必须使用自动驾驶，因为你无法手动使用远距离驱动器。角色除非你每隔几小时手动喂他们一次，否则就会死，这也让远距离航行变得极其烦人。在快进时让他们自动消耗食物、水和睡觉本该是件很简单的事，但他们却只会随机死掉。

而且对此真的没什么可说的。主游戏循环包括打捞各种废弃飞船、逐步建造自己的飞船、偿还你在初始飞船上的贷款，同时避免在燃料和氧气上花太多钱。这方面还算有点意思，但游戏的主要难点本质上就是记住你把某样东西放在哪里了。这让用备用零件进行建造和修理变得很繁琐。只追踪少数几种在机制上不同的地板，并把地板贴图与类型分开，会是个好主意，墙壁也是如此。造船很有趣，但由于存储机制而相当繁琐。电力机制非常不透明，而且没有办法看到某样东西会消耗多少电。有一个角色成长系统，嗯，也许吧，它仍然会提升你已经拥有的技能，而当它们终于达到100%时，你什么也得不到，但它看起来确实存在……所需的工作量也变化极大且不成比例。战斗和对话很糟糕，同样主要是因为糟糕的UI。如果进入一种不同类型的菜单来处理这些，而不是需要四处滚动并猜测东西是干什么的，那会更好。

还应该有与管理食物、饮水、大气和热量相关的难度，但这些系统维护起来几乎微不足道，或者就是有bug。也没有食物、饮水、废物等的回收利用，没有温室，而且奇怪的是没有太阳能板或放射性同位素发电机。偶尔的断电、断燃料或导航站崩溃都是有趣的迷你事件，但在某些情况下可能惩罚过重。

有一个有趣的角色创建过程，但它相当有限，而且在不知道任何东西是干什么的情况下，乐趣也会减少。

问题在于bug。比如你的角色毫无明确理由地装备上太空头盔，然后在空气耗尽后失去意识，而当时你还在自己飞船内部，那里的大气明明没问题。比如各种角色状态条难以解读，或者同样有bug。比如几个月都不需要上厕所，然后突然因为过去几分钟内没上过厕所而反复濒临死亡。比如如果你在某个地方待上几个小时，空间站人员就会像苍蝇一样倒下，留下他们的贵重物品。比如失去左键点击物体的能力，而这是主要的交互方式；比如角色以各种方式随机自杀。游戏加载和保存也慢得惊人，而这是修复大多数bug的唯一方法。请升级到带arena的protobuf，别再使用压缩的json了……另外，游戏在搜索有效路径和有效拖运位置时，非常需要为A*提供更长的搜索范围。

这款游戏真的很有前景，但还没准备好发布。如果你愿意忍受大量不直观的UI和粗糙感，游戏目前这样也挺好玩，但它仍然需要大量工作。

items.text:
Ostranauts is a sandbox space sim, if you're a fan of hardcore and unforgiving games like Kenshi or Project Zomboid, you're in for a treat. Compared to other space sims, the focus is also ( And maybe even more ) on your character instead of being only on the ship.

I'm 100+ hours in and I haven't left the starting area, I'm having a lot of fun just by salvaging ships and expanding mine, so i can't tell exactly how much content there's in now beside the ship building part.

It also has its fair share of bugs and some performance issues, but by being at this early stage of development it's understandable, rest assured because the devs are extremely active with updates and bug fixes, and they also engage with the community about feedbacks, suggestions and bug reports.

I'd say to give it a try, considered that there aren't a lot of space sims with features like Ostranauts.

This game is my new addiction. Haven't been playing for long, but I know I'll be on this for a WHOLE lot longer. At first, I was definitely stumped by the game's difficulty curve, especially ship navigation and the foreign UI. (I even ended up refunding it for a good day before immediately repurchasing it, thanks to privatel1mes' amazing series)

I tend to see learning this game as more of a molehill than a mountain. If you take breaks when you get frustrated and have fun trying to push the limits of the game, you'll find a foothold, start raking in cash and enjoy this game to its fullest. (also don't forget to save-scum as much as possible)

Overall, despite some reload-fixable bugs and slightly janky AI, this game shows a LOT of promise and already has me hooked, and could hook you too. Try it out!

items.text:
Slowly being able to recommend this game as more and more fixes (and QoL) get implemented through patch cycles.

Originally I would've given this a [b]heavy[/b] thumbs down because the amount of bugs in the game was extremely impeding to actual play.  There were points where I couldn't go more than [b]20 seconds[/b] without having to reload the save due to a bug.  It was infuriating and caused me to quit playing, especially as it compounded ontop of all the other issues.

Now, there's still a lot of bugs, and the game performance is quite poor (both FPS, stuttering and load times; more on loading later), but a lot of the severe ones have gotten fixed.  The game still has high memory consumption, and presumably memory leaks, which leads to lower performance and more severe stuttering the longer the client runs.  [i]I will not give it a "thumbs up" just yet.[/i].

If you're thinking about trying the game, I would recommend looking at Quill18's playthrough of it, either the first livestream he did, or his Youtube series.  It's a good starter for breaking the ice and learning the basic ropes of the game (especially without immediately failing).

What I want to really focus on here is getting more word out about the [b]save/load system[/b].

[strike] Currently, and presumably for the last 4 years, the game has used an archive system for its save files.  Everything is in JSON files, which are then archived (zipped).  Save files are [b]extremely large[/b] when uncompressed (2 day old save is 200MB).  The compression and decompression process heavily slows down saving/loading.

But, the worst thing about this process is that [b]every single time you load your game, the archive is unzipped into a temp folder, loaded into memory, then deleted[/b].  Even if you do absolutely nothing in the save and just quit to menu and reload it, it does this whole process over again instead of using anything that's still residing in memory and matching the data.

In simpler terms:  When you load your save it's [b]writing 200MB+[/b] to your disk drive (probably an SSD).

If you've been playing this game for any length of time, you have gigabytes upon gigabytes, probably even terabytes after a year, of save data writing.

Another user and I have tried to bring this issue up in the Discord, but it hasn't really had any attention.

The developer must add a way to uncompress the zip archive into memory directly (which we discussed is possible in Unity), or rewrite the entire save system to be something other than massive JSON files which JSON editors struggle to even handle (browsers crash, vstudio doesn't support, vscode struggles and no plugin works properly).  Even just using the uncompressed files themselves would avoid much of this data writing issue.

In the interim, I recommend anyone who's playing this game symlink the game's user folder over to a HDD.  It's slower to save/load, yes, but it avoids eating away at your SSD's limited write cycles.[/strike]

[b]EDIT[/b]: This has finally been changed.  Temporarily editing the review this way to not leave out of date information up.
---


[b]Regardless, despite my thumbs down, if you're the type of person who enjoys games like this, you will find enjoyment here[/b].  It's cheap, a sale knocks off a few bucks, and since the Kitfox deal, it seems there's been more rapid development as they aim for a 1.0 release next year.  While I don't think a "1.0" release is really fitting in just a year (content wise), it certainly seems better going than it was previously.

Also, check out the mods in Discord, some are really great QoL and vastly improve the experience.


[i]nb: you can launch the game outside of Steam, so my recorded hours are not representative of my total playtime, which is well over 100 so far[/i]
items.text_zh:
随着补丁周期中越来越多的修复（以及生活质量改进）得到落实，我正慢慢能够推荐这款游戏。

最初我会给它一个[b]强烈[/b]的差评，因为游戏中的bug数量极其妨碍实际游玩。有些时候，我[b]20秒[/b]都撑不过去，就因为一个bug不得不重新加载存档。这让人怒不可遏，导致我放弃了游玩，尤其是当它叠加在所有其他问题之上时。

现在，仍然有很多bug，游戏性能也相当糟糕（帧率、卡顿和加载时间都是如此；关于加载后面会详细说），但很多严重的问题已经得到修复。游戏仍然有很高的内存消耗，想必还有内存泄漏，这导致客户端运行时间越长，性能越低，卡顿越严重。[i]我还不会给它“好评”。[/i]。

如果你正在考虑尝试这款游戏，我建议看看Quill18的游玩视频，要么是他第一次直播的内容，要么是他的YouTube系列。这是一个很好的入门材料，可以打破僵局并学习游戏的基本要领（尤其是避免一上来就失败）。

我在这里真正想重点谈的是让更多人了解[b]存档/读档系统[/b]。

[strike]目前，而且想必在过去4年里，游戏一直使用归档系统来保存存档文件。所有内容都在JSON文件中，然后被归档（压缩）。未压缩时存档文件[b]极其庞大[/b]（2天前的存档就有200MB）。压缩和解压缩过程严重拖慢了保存/加载速度。

但这个过程最糟糕的地方在于，[b]每次你加载游戏时，归档文件都会被解压到一个临时文件夹，加载到内存中，然后被删除[/b]。即使你在存档中什么都不做，只是退出到菜单再重新加载，它也会把整个过程重来一遍，而不是利用任何仍然驻留在内存中且与数据匹配的内容。

用更简单的话说：当你加载存档时，它正在向你的磁盘驱动器（可能是SSD）[b]写入200MB以上[/b]的数据。

如果你玩这款游戏有一段时间了，你已经写入了数以GB计、甚至一年后可能数以TB计的存档数据。

我和另一位用户曾试图在Discord上提出这个问题，但并没有真正引起任何关注。

开发者必须添加一种方法，将zip归档直接解压到内存中（我们讨论过这在Unity中是可行的），或者重写整个存档系统，使其不再是庞大的JSON文件——JSON编辑器甚至连处理它们都很吃力（浏览器崩溃，vstudio不支持，vscode很吃力，没有插件能正常工作）。即使只是使用未压缩的文件本身，也能避免大部分这种数据写入问题。

在此期间，我建议任何玩这款游戏的人把游戏的用户文件夹符号链接到HDD上。是的，保存/加载会更慢，但这可以避免消耗你SSD有限的写入寿命。[strike]

[b]编辑[/b]：这个问题终于被改变了。暂时以这种方式编辑评测，以免留下过时的信息。
---


[b]无论如何，尽管我给了差评，如果你是那种喜欢这类游戏的人，你会在这里找到乐趣[/b]。它很便宜，打折时还能再省几块钱，而且自从Kitfox交易以来，似乎开发速度加快了，因为他们目标是在明年发布1.0版本。虽然我认为仅仅一年就发布“1.0”（从内容角度来说）并不太合适，但它
肯定看起来比之前进展得更好了。

另外，去看看Discord里的模组，有些真的很棒，能大幅提升生活质量，极大地改善游戏体验。


[i]注：你可以在Steam之外启动游戏，所以我记录的时长并不代表我的总游戏时间，到目前为止我的总时长早已超过100小时[/i]

items.text:
This game scratches an itch I didn't know I had. Something about spending hours mucking about in shattered vessels just brings me joy. This early access game told a story with my humble spacer as the protagonist. Sure, they usually met a horrible death to the cruel void, but it was the journey there that I remember. The first time I purchased my own derelict craft and slowly brought her back to life was really special. Hell - I felt sad when my work was complete and I sold her off for a hefty profit.

Of course, there are problems. The game can be somewhat unstable at times, and once you starting getting deep into the game it can get quite stuttery, I assume due to the fact it saves everything that occurs. I can forgive this though, due to the early access nature of the game. Plus- the early game is more enjoyable for me anyway.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏挠到了我此前不知道自己有的痒处。在支离破碎的飞船里瞎折腾几个小时，不知怎的就是能给我带来快乐。这款抢先体验游戏以我那个卑微的太空人为主角讲述了一个故事。当然，他们通常会惨死于残酷的虚空，但我记得的是通往那里的旅程。我第一次买下属于自己的废弃飞船，并慢慢让她重获生机时，那真的很特别。见鬼——当我的工作完成、我以高价把她卖掉时，我竟然感到难过。

当然，也有问题。这款游戏有时会有些不稳定，而且一旦你开始深入游玩，它就会变得相当卡顿，我猜是因为它会保存发生的一切。不过考虑到这款游戏处于抢先体验阶段，我可以原谅这一点。再说——反正对我来说，游戏前期更有趣。

items.text:
New update rendered my whole review obsolete only two weeks after I posted it which is a very good sign. For example they changed the context menu to appear at the mouse location among other things that previously annoyed me. It seem like the developers are very aware of what they are doing. Either that or they read my review, lol. In any case it means the development is going forward in the right direction ;)

I officially change my review from weak to strong.

[i][strike]Oh my god whatta mess. The only thing I like about the UI is the theme. Everything else is a total disaster. For example, right clicking on stuff brings up a context menu, but the menu does not appear where you click. It appears at the bottom so you have to move the mouse aaaaaall the way to the bottom of the screen to select an option.

Context menus should always appear at the mouse arrow. My gawd, that is like the first thing the teach you at the UI programming academy.

Also, many-many-many bugs. So many bugs I guess they had to remove the bug reporting forum because it was overcrowded, because I cant find it. It is on the verge on being defined as unplayable. My first playthrough I thought I was stupid because I couldn't dock with a ship. I spent 2 hours trying to dock. I learned it was a bug much later.

Pause/play feature is totally uninutive. I really don't know how to play it? It unpauses automatically when you give your character orders so you have to manually pause after each order you try to stack on your character. So if you give your chacter five orders (which is an effort in itself moving the mouse aaaall the way down to the middle of the screen to find the right context menu option), you have to pause the game five times. Help?

But I believe it could be fun even though it is totally unintuitive sometime in a distant future, so this is a very, very weak recommendation.[/i][/strike]
items.text_zh:
新的更新让我整个评测在发布仅两周后就过时了，这是个非常好的迹象。例如，他们把上下文菜单改成了在鼠标位置出现，还有其他一些以前让我烦恼的事情。看起来开发者非常清楚自己在做什么。要么就是他们读了我的评测，哈哈。无论如何，这意味着开发正朝着正确的方向前进 ;)

我正式将我的评测从弱推荐改为强烈推荐。

[i][strike]天哪，真是一团糟。关于UI我唯一喜欢的就是主题。其他一切都是彻底的灾难。例如，右键点击东西会弹出上下文菜单，但菜单不会出现在你点击的地方。它出现在底部，所以你必须把鼠标移动aaaaalllll way到屏幕底部才能选择一个选项。

上下文菜单应该总是出现在鼠标箭头处。我的天，这就像是UI编程学院教你的第一件事。

另外，很多很多很多的bug。这么多bug，我猜他们不得不删除bug报告论坛，因为它太拥挤了，因为我找不到它。它几乎要被定义为无法游玩了。我第一次游玩时以为自己很蠢，因为我无法与一艘船对接。我花了2个小时试图对接。很久之后我才知道那是个bug。

暂停/播放功能完全不直观。我真的不知道该怎么玩？当你给你的角色下达命令时，它会自动取消暂停，所以你必须在每个你试图堆叠在角色身上的命令后手动暂停。所以如果你给你的角色下达五个命令（这本身就是一种努力，要把鼠标移动aaaaalllll way到屏幕中间找到正确的上下文菜单选项），你必须暂停游戏五次。求助？

但我相信它在遥远的未来可能会很有趣，尽管有时它完全不直观，所以这是一个非常、非常弱的推荐。[i][/strike]

items.text:
I really want to like this game, and mechanically it seems quite fun. 

However that all gets thrown out the game when it just decides to end your save.

to summarize my experience, i read through all of the manual except the parts about the nuclear reactor, (while doing that i tab out reply to some discord messages, have to go replace some fire alarm batteries.) go into a game, follow the tutorial get to my first ship i dock to it. i literally docked to a front half of a docking clamp, to a wreckage thats like 20 wall tiles, 15 floor tiles, some scrap and a corpse. 

i then get pulled over by the police for illegal salvaging, something i didn't even actually realize was illegal until i see the message from them pulling me over. ( i think the manuel mentions it, but its like 8 pages of technical stuff when you just want to get into playing a game so it doesn't exactly all stick) i get fined 15,000 ( i started with 98.0) i have no idea why i got pulled over and how to stop that, maybe i wasn't supposed to stay that long at the site, maybe you are supposed to turn off your transponder who knows. game or manual doesn't mention anything. 

i eventually go back to the starting station, after mildly looting a 2nd wreckage that seemed to have a very bugged out procedural generation. trying to only take what i can quickly grab with my transponder off to hopefully not get found by the police again. at this point i'm down to 30% rcs fuel so i head back to the station i spawned at to sell all the scrap and N2 canister i yoinked, plus some pda's i grabbed. turned in a dead pirates bounty i found in the 2nd ship. all in all, made about 2k ish. i pay off all my station fees hoping i can ignore the police fine for awhile, (basically cost all my money to pay for docking) get told i can't leave without paying the 15k. i go to the station authority to see if i can get an extension or something. ( a dude who earlier called me on the station speakers, and asked me to plant a bug on some other dude, AND DIDN'T PAY ME OR ANYTHING FOR IT.) dude says no when i request to pay it next time. 

so the save is basically bricked. i can't leave the station until i earn over 7 times what i earned in my entire time in the game over 3 hours. the only way i could maybe get out of this i found was to do kiosk jobs to local deliveries. but the kisok jobs actively suck. if you try to take one, it doesn't let you unless you are at the specific one thats the pick up point, but by the time you move from the one you checked to the pick up point the job has despawned. thus its actually impossible without very lucky rng to even pick up one of the jobs. all while the station fines you for being docked by the hour. and it seems you have to pay to pick up the jobs. 

can't even refund cause it took me 3 hours to go through all this. 

but yeah. TL;DR game has some fun mechanics, but your save can get completely bricked by something it doesn't even really tell you is a thing, and then theres nothing you can do to recover. when all you did was LITERALLY LISTEN TO THE TUTORIAL. if they let salvaging without a license be legal then it'd be a really fun game. (which by the way is 5k a day. again literally 2.5 times more than i made in 3 hours of playing, and if i recall almost a full in game day.)
items.text_zh:
我真的很想喜欢这款游戏，而且从机制上看它似乎相当有趣。

然而，当它突然决定终结你的存档时，这一切都被抛到了九霄云外。

总结一下我的经历：我读完了整本手册，除了关于核反应堆的部分，（读的时候我切出去回复了一些Discord消息，还得去换一些火灾报警器的电池。）进入游戏，跟着教程走，到达了我的第一艘船，我停靠了上去。我实际上停靠到了一个对接夹的前半部分，连着一堆大约20块墙砖、15块地砖、一些废料和一具尸体的残骸。

然后我因为非法打捞被警察拦下了，直到我看到他们拦停我的消息之前，我甚至都没意识到这是违法的。（我想手册里提到过，但那大概是8页的技术性内容，而你只是想赶紧开始玩游戏，所以它并不完全能让人记住。）我被罚款15,000（我一开始只有98.0）。我完全不知道自己为什么被拦下，也不知道怎么避免这种情况，也许我不该在那个地点停留那么久，也许你应该关掉你的应答器，谁知道呢。游戏或手册都没有提到任何相关内容。

i最终回到了起始空间站，在那之前我稍微洗劫了第二个残骸，那个残骸的程序生成似乎有严重的bug。我尽量只拿那些能快速抓取的东西，同时关掉应答器，希望能不再被警察发现。此时我的RCS燃料只剩下30%，所以我回到了我出生的空间站，卖掉了我顺来的所有废料和N2罐，还有我拿的一些PDA。上交了我在第二艘船上找到的一个死海盗的赏金。总而言之，赚了大约2千左右。我付清了所有空间站费用，希望可以暂时无视警察的罚款，（基本上花光了我所有的钱来支付停靠费）结果被告知不付那15k就不能离开。我去找空间站管理局，看看能不能延期什么的。（就是之前通过空间站扬声器呼叫我，让我去给另一个人装窃听器，而且没付我钱也没给任何报酬的那个人。）当我请求下次再付时，那家伙说不行。

所以这个存档基本上算是废了。在赚到超过我整个游戏3小时里所赚的7倍之前，我无法离开空间站。我发现的唯一可能摆脱困境的方法是做自助终端的工作，比如本地送货。但自助终端的工作烂透了。如果你想接一个，除非你正好在特定的取货点，否则它不让你接，但等你从你查看的那个终端移动到取货点时，工作已经消失了。因此，除非运气极好，否则根本不可能接到任何一个工作。与此同时，空间站还按小时对你停靠收费。而且看起来你还得付钱才能接这些工作。

甚至没法退款，因为我花了3个小时才经历完这一切。

但没错。TL;DR 游戏有一些有趣的机制，但你的存档可能会被一些它甚至没有真正告诉过你存在的东西彻底搞废，然后你对此无能为力。而你所做的只是字面意义上地听从了教程。如果他们让无证打捞合法化，那它会是一款非常有趣的游戏。（顺便说一下，许可证是每天5千。再次强调，这字面意义上是我玩3个小时所赚的2.5倍多，如果我没记错的话，差不多是整整一个游戏日。）

♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥, what a really really great game?!? It's basically: Be a real person in space that is living on her space ship, trucking the space lanes. And you can even sit in your space kitchen made from salvage of plundered derelicts. Set your ship on a route. Leave the helm. Do things in the ship. Suddenly the alarm rings. There's wreckage on your route or you didn't watch the clock and are already a mere seconds away from crashing into Ganymed. Now run to get into the pilot seat. I love it. I'm 76 hours in. Because I was sick home last week, when I bought it!

Admittedly, there are some shadows. The UI is a little unintuitive. Left click move, right click show infos, which you get in the upper right. Then you have to look into the middle lower side of the screen to see interactions. That takes a moment to get used to it. A few other things. The AI, when you automatize crew ... uhm ... has room for improvements? The dialogue system is a hassle at it's current state. Too many options, too many repetitions. Expect bugs. Send bug reports to their discord.

But that's solvable and compared to the awesome home in space that you'll build? A small price zu pay.

EDIT: A few more hours in the game. It's still a gem, but with steadily improving UI and a decreasing number of bugs.

items.text:
I'm conflicted on this game. It's on one hand a terrific space scavenger-trader sim with very enjoyable gameplay and great atmosphere. On the other hand it's really janky. Between general instability, weird glitches and performance issues, this game can be a hostile experience for all the wrong reasons, and when you take into account that it's been in early access for 4 years and is expected to be released in 2025, you have to wonder what that full release will look like. 

I'm giving this a positive review despite the technical problems of the game for two reasons: 
1) I'm not aware of any game quite like it and I genuinely love playing it despite all the bug-related frustration.
2) It may have been early access for a long while, but it's still early access. I can understand focusing on design and content in the pre-release stage, even at the expense of a stable experience. My hope here is that the devs will take care to address at least a significant chunk of the existing stability and performance issues prior to full release. The last couple of patches (at the time of writing) look like they were meant to do just that.

尽管游戏存在技术问题，我还是给了它好评，原因有两个：
1）我不知道有任何游戏与它完全相似，尽管有所有与 bug 相关的挫败感，我真心喜欢玩它。
2）它可能已经抢先体验了很长时间，但它仍然是抢先体验。我能理解在发布前阶段专注于设计和内容，即使以牺牲稳定的体验为代价。我在这里的希望是，开发者会在完整发布之前，至少解决现有稳定性和性能问题中的很大一部分。最近几个补丁（在撰写本文时）看起来正是为了做到这一点。

items.text:
I first bought this game early 2023 - I remember the first time I played it I couldn't figure out how to get out of the apartment. There was some puzzle, repairing the door, I couldn't figure out what the game wanted me to do and after ten minutes or so of trying, I gave up, and figured I'd give the game more time to bake. A few months later, I tried again, got out of my room, couldn't find where the ship was. I dropped it again and wrote it off as a game that just wasn't for me. I stumbled across a couple of youtube playthroughs that were pretty interesting to watch - the game looked a lot more straightforward, and looked like fun. I picked it back up and... it's a really good game now. It's pretty fun. Still very complex, and still unintuative in many ways, but it's a pretty solid game now, in fact it has one of the best flight models for a space game I've seen. The salvaging/repairing/building/etc is also very good, and when I've played I can kinda tell that there's a lot more going on that I haven't seen yet. The six hours I've played has barely scratched the surface. There's still a lot I don't know, I'm constantly googling how to do certain things in game, but that's okay, because it feels worth my time it at this point. 
Ostranauts is still in early access with plenty of bugs some game breaking that I've run into a few in my short time playing - don't enter the security ship if you get boarded for example, but it is other than that stable. If you like your scifi realistic and near future, if you like roguelikes, if you like games that you need to have a manual on hand, this might be the game for you. If you're on the fence I'd recommend quill18's playthrough - it hooked me.

我在2023年初第一次买了这个游戏——我记得第一次玩的时候，我搞不懂怎么走出公寓。有个谜题，修理门，我搞不懂游戏想让我做什么，试了大约十分钟后，我放弃了，想着给游戏更多时间完善。几个月后，我又试了一次，走出了我的房间，却找不到飞船在哪里。我又放下了它，把它归类为不适合我的游戏。我偶然看到几个youtube通关视频，看起来挺有意思——游戏看起来直接多了，也看起来很好玩。我重新拿起它，然后……它现在真的是个好游戏。相当好玩。仍然非常复杂，在很多方面仍然不直观，但它现在是个相当扎实的游戏，事实上它拥有我见过的太空游戏中最棒的飞行模型之一。打捞/修理/建造等等也非常好，当我玩的时候，我能感觉到还有很多我尚未看到的内容。我玩的六个小时 barely 触及了表面。还有很多我不知道的东西，我不断在谷歌上搜索如何在游戏中做某些事情，但没关系，因为此刻它感觉值得我花时间。
Ostranauts仍处于抢先体验阶段，有很多bug，有些会破坏游戏，我在短暂游玩中遇到了几个——例如，如果你被登船，不要进入安全船，但除此之外它是稳定的。如果你喜欢现实主义和近未来的科幻，如果你喜欢roguelike，如果你喜欢需要手边有手册的游戏，这可能是适合你的游戏。如果你还在犹豫，我推荐quill18的通关视频——它吸引了我。

items.text: Bought the game when it first came out, refunded for technical issues. Later bought again, played it here and there. I'm going to say it was probably a new mechanic added for the starter ships to show how they really are coffins. Within my first hour of gameplay, I ran into an issue where I couldn't move/select my character, couldn't click any menu options, and had to force quit the game. I want to love this game, but there just isn't much substance, majority of the mechanics make things frustrating, game turns into a menu navigator very quickly, and the bugs/issues.

最后一次崩溃是当我被警察拦下，协商了一个警告，然后当我回到我的飞船时——我想是在我还在走过去的时候我们自动脱离对接了。角色消失了，摄像机开始旋转，日志显示我受到了伤害，死了。

当它正常工作时，它是一个有趣的游戏，很酷的概念，艺术风格不错，但大多数时候真的很难分辨你在看什么。这很令人失望。游戏早期我合法地被锁在我的房间里，因为我无法“看到”它指向我的架子。

最后，当我确实拆解了两艘飞船，我回来了，卖掉了我的货物，发现我没有拆解“正确的东西”，因为我赚的300美元没有覆盖500美元的对接费。我本可以拿更多废料，但我得到的飞船很小。所以我什么都装不下。之前那个角色的飞船，有缺失的块，无法保持压力，所有警报都在响。所以那也是一次重启。

items.text:
I love this game and have owned it for years, it has so much potential but I can't recommend it because of how buggy and unpolished it is. Major QoL issues, an aggravating UI, constant major bugs, and absolutely abysmal AI lead to an extremely frustrating experience. Multiple major components of the game are plagued with numerous bugs, many that have been around for a long time.

They really need to do a major patch cycle where they just fix bugs, streamline the UI/UX, fix the AI (to the point where they're at least capable of staying alive), and focus on performance. 

I can't wait to change this to a positive review.

EDIT: changing this to positive as they're clearly hammering out bugs
EDIT2: changing this back to negative as they shipped this as a 1.0 finished game. yikes.

items.text:
Before you buy - do note that this game will be better in future, a lot is planned.
Recently a new open betatest patch has been released, .14 that would be, and it is a big leap to what has been in game before. They have added atmosphere to planets, gravity and its effects, including movement g-forces, and a few other things, as well as made gui easier to read. 

I would say if you want to support developers and not afraid to wait a few years until game is finished - welcome.
And you can play it now, it does work, but it will only get better with time from what it is now.

Pros
+ Immersive
Quite a lot immersive elements, gui sometimes, worldbuilding really does it. Oxygen, heat, part decay and tools, there are a lot of elements there. Even each docking session is a minigame of sorts, which is close to how it is in real life, but in 2d movement and way greater speeds. It leaves space for fun, after all. THERE ARE GUIDES TO REACTOR, NAV CONSOLE AND STUFF THAT LOOK LIKE REAL MANUALS! I have almost never seen that in other games, it really adds to it.
+ Free to explore and roleplay
You can be anything you want and manage to be. Want to work under corp you were born into? Or you want to go outlaw and refuse to pay docking fees anymore? Or you want to reject society and just kill everyone you find your hands on? Heck, you can get your ship in a mortgage and just not pay it, though it will result large fines that you will be forced to pay once you dock to public station, unfortunately. You can become a sort of pirate, docking to other people ships, killing them and them scrapping their ships for parts, since no-one will ask where they come from, no witnesses.
Or you can become an interplanetry trader that multiplies money. Or you can roleplay as moron and go outside of airlock without a helmet on.
+ Quite a few mysteries
Unfortunately, cant write much here, its not fun if you dont figure this yourself, but first interaction with REDACTED will leave you REDACTED and that is REDACTED. Also, first time I saw REDACTED I have REDACTED, I kid you not. 
Purple suit is a lie purple suit is a lie purple suit is a lie purple suit is REDACTED
+ Quite some content
There is some content already present, enough for a ~40 hours if you really want to visit it all and know how to, but most of that time you will make money, though. Thankfully, most of it will happen as you collect money, in-between.
+ Ship building system
It is not too hard, not too easy. Just ideal in my opinion - you dont have to micromanage every wire and pipe, yet you cant just slap some gas cans on a box and call it a ship - you need more than that, especially if you want to fly on it longer than a day or two. You dont HAVE to seal the hull, but you will last as long as your suits oxygen/power. You dont need a reactor, but you will essentially run on accumulators, which means if you dont manage your power closely you will find yourself stranded on piece of scrap hundreds of kilometers off any station. Oh, and now that they added atmosphere, you can fly in there and its somewhat complex, you cant just strap some wings and propellers on your 200 tonned hauler and expect if to fly. 
+ Devs are cool people
This is more of a personal one, but you can talk to them on games discord channel, they often show up there and talk to people, they dont hide and interact frequently, which means if you really want to you can influence games development in a way, perhaps. After seeing a lot of those detached companies that just make profit and think of their customers as "big needy babies" this is some fresh air.
+ Price
It is somewhat cheap, it is certainly not expensive. Right now might be a bit too much, but you can think of it as a pre-order of sorts, thats why its early access, but in my country its costs as a large mcdonalds meal, unlike some other games that can reach costs of a new smartphone.

There are some cons, though, cant be without it
- Game is somewhat raw
Yes, there is some content already, but if you really look into it there isnt that much to do. Until recently there was only one planetoid and surrounding stations available, which really limited what you can and will do. 
- Bugs, bugs!
They are everywhere, such is the way. But you can report them though, there is an easy form you can do that in devs discord, but takes time to fix, and some of them can be really annoying, like 6 hours timeskip doesnt empty your sleep need, while sitting for 30 minutes with 16x time speed will. 
- Lack of multiplayer
This is unfortunate, as I really would like to play this game with my friends, but such is the nature of this game that this is simply not possible. Although, they might make a pvp mode just for that, maybe...
- Some features lacking
Yes, games bones and some meat are in place, but small features really make it annoying, like, there is no way to replenish small oxygen canisters, if you try to fill them up with normal pumps they just blow up, because they pump more pressure in one tick than that poor alluminum bottle can take. There is a crew system, but there are barely any uses for them. Sure, you can just order them to completly dissasemble some ship and haul it all home, or use second crew member as your character while main one sleeps, but you have to pay them and there is a death fee you pay if they go outside of airlock without a helmet, and for some reason they do that more often than I would want... Yes, there is a way to buy citizenship and get an apartment of your own, but you can only buy same one, they didnt add more yet. Again, this is to be added in future, they have confirmed that, this is more of a "buy now" con.
- lack of variety in some things.
There are only 3 food brands, cheap af preserfved food with like 10 variations of flavout and two street vendors, who offer 3 dishes each. Few tools - screwdriver, hacksaw, their better versions angle grinder and power drill, small welder, soldering tool and their better alternative, laser tool. And crowbar. Could really use a few more brands/variations of tools, so that there are diffrent brands of power drill for example, even if its just 2 or 3. Not that critical compared to some other things, like, game has illegal station with "drug seller" but no drugs except for 4 types of pills (medical), 3 types of injections (medical) and basically thats it.
items.text_zh:
在你购买之前——请注意，这款游戏在未来会变得更好，有很多计划。
最近发布了一个新的公开测试补丁，应该是.14版本，与之前游戏中的内容相比是一个巨大的飞跃。他们为行星添加了大气层、重力及其效果，包括移动时的G力，以及其他一些东西，还让GUI更易于阅读。

我想说，如果你想支持开发者并且不怕等上几年直到游戏完成——欢迎。
而且你现在就可以玩，它确实能运行，但随着时间的推移，它只会比现在更好。

优点
+ 沉浸感
有相当多的沉浸元素，有时是GUI，世界构建真的做到了。氧气、热量、部件老化和工具，那里有很多元素。甚至每次对接都算是一种小游戏，这接近现实生活中的情况，但采用2D移动和更快的速度。毕竟，这为乐趣留下了空间。有关于反应堆、导航控制台之类的东西的指南，看起来像真正的手册！我几乎从未在其他游戏中见过这种，它真的增加了沉浸感。
+ 自由探索和角色扮演
你可以成为任何你想成为并能做到的人。想在你出生的公司下工作？或者你想成为不法之徒，拒绝再支付对接费？或者你想拒绝社会，杀掉你遇到的每一个人？哎呀，你可以用抵押贷款买船然后就不还，不过不幸的是，这会导致巨额罚款，一旦你停靠到公共空间站就不得不支付。你可以成为某种海盗，停靠到别人的船上，杀死他们，然后拆解他们的船获取零件，因为没人会问这些零件从哪来，没有目击者。
或者你可以成为星际商人，让钱翻倍。或者你可以扮演白痴，不戴头盔就走出气闸。
+ 相当多的谜团
不幸的是，这里不能写太多，如果你不自己弄清楚就不好玩了，但与[已编辑]的第一次互动会让你[已编辑]，那就是[已编辑]。另外，我第一次看到[已编辑]时我[已编辑]，我没骗你。
紫色套装是谎言 紫色套装是谎言 紫色套装是谎言 紫色套装是[已编辑]
+ 相当多的内容
目前已经有一些内容，如果你真的想全部参观并且知道怎么做，足够玩大约40小时，不过大部分时间你都会在赚钱。幸运的是，大部分内容会在你赚钱的过程中顺便发生。
+ 飞船建造系统
不太难，也不太简单。在我看来刚刚好——你不必微观管理每一根电线和管道，但也不能随便把几个气罐贴在一个盒子上就称之为飞船——你需要的不止这些，特别是如果你想在它上面飞行超过一两天。你不必密封船体，但你的持续时间取决于你宇航服的氧气/电力。你不需要反应堆，但你基本上会靠蓄电池运行，这意味着如果你不密切管理电力，你会发现自己搁浅在离任何空间站数百公里外的一堆废铁上。哦，既然他们添加了大气层，你可以飞进去，而且这有点复杂，你不能只是给200吨的运输船绑上一些翅膀和螺旋桨就指望它能飞。
+ 开发者是好人
这更多是个人感受，但你可以在游戏的Discord频道上和他们交谈，他们经常出现在那里和人聊天，他们不隐藏并且频繁互动，这意味着如果你真的想，你或许能以某种方式影响游戏的发展。在看到很多那些冷漠无情、只想着赚钱、把顾客当成“嗷嗷待哺的大婴儿”的公司之后，这真是一股新鲜空气。
+ 价格
它算是有点便宜，肯定不贵。现在可能有点太贵了，但你可以把它看作某种预购，这就是为什么它是抢先体验，但在我所在的国家，它的价格相当于一顿大份麦当劳套餐，不像其他一些游戏能达到一部新智能手机的价格。

不过也有一些缺点，不可能没有
- 游戏还有些粗糙
是的，已经有一些内容了，但如果你真的深入看，其实没那么多可做的。直到最近，只有一个星体和周围的站点可用，这真的限制了你能够和将会做的事情。
- 漏洞，漏洞！
它们到处都是，就是这样。但你可以报告它们，在开发者的Discord里有一个简单的表格可以做到，但修复需要时间，而且其中一些真的很烦人，比如6小时的时间跳跃不会清空你的睡眠需求，而用16倍时间速度坐30分钟却会。
- 缺少多人游戏
这很不幸，因为我真的很想和朋友们一起玩这个游戏，但这款游戏的性质就是这样，这根本不可能。不过，他们也许可能会专门为此做一个PvP模式，也许……
- 缺少一些功能
是的，游戏的骨架和一些肉已经到位，但小功能真的让人烦，比如，没有办法补充小型氧气罐，如果你试图用普通泵给它们充气，它们就会爆炸，因为泵在一个tick内注入的压力超过了那个可怜的铝瓶所能承受的。有一个船员系统，但几乎没有多少用途。当然，你可以直接命令他们完全拆解某艘船并把所有东西运回家，或者在主角色睡觉时使用第二个船员作为你的角色，但你必须付钱给他们，而且如果他们不戴头盔走出气闸，你还要支付死亡费用，而不知为何他们这样做的频率比我想要的更高……是的，有办法购买公民身份并获得你自己的公寓，但你只能买同一个，他们还没有添加更多。再次，这是未来要添加的，他们已经确认了，这更多是一个“现在购买”的缺点。
- 某些东西缺乏多样性。
只有3个食品品牌，便宜得要命的保存食品，大约有10种口味变化，还有两个街头小贩，每个提供3道菜。工具很少——螺丝刀、钢锯、它们更好的版本角磨机和电钻、小型焊机、焊接工具及其更好的替代品激光工具。还有撬棍。真的可以多用几个品牌/工具变体，比如有不同品牌的电钻，哪怕只有2或3个。相比其他一些事情，这不算太关键，比如，游戏有一个非法空间站，里面有“毒品贩子”，但除了4种药片（医疗）、3种注射剂（医疗）之外基本上没有毒品，差不多就是这样。
那些只想着赚钱、把顾客当成“嗷嗷待哺的大婴儿”的冷漠公司，这真是一股清流。
+ 价格
它算是有点便宜，绝对不算贵。现在可能有点偏贵，但你可以把它当成某种预购，这就是为什么它处于抢先体验阶段，不过在我的国家，它的价格相当于一份大号麦当劳套餐，不像其他一些游戏能贵到一部新智能手机的价格。

不过也有一些缺点，不可能没有
- 游戏还有点粗糙
是的，已经有一些内容了，但如果你真的深入去看，其实没那么多可做的。直到最近，只有一个星体和周围的站点可用，这真的限制了你能够和将会做的事情。
- Bug，Bug！
它们无处不在，就是这样。不过你可以报告它们，在开发者的Discord里有一个简单的表格可以填，但修复需要时间，而且有些Bug真的很烦人，比如6小时的时间跳跃不会清空你的睡眠需求，而坐着用16倍时间速度过30分钟却会。
- 缺少多人模式
这很不幸，因为我真的很想和朋友们一起玩这个游戏，但这个游戏的性质就是这样，这根本不可能。不过，他们也许可能会专门为此做一个PvP模式，也许吧……
- 缺少一些功能
是的，游戏的骨架和一些血肉已经到位，但一些小功能真的很让人恼火，比如，没有办法补充小型氧气罐，如果你试图用普通泵给它们充气，它们就会爆炸，因为泵在一个tick内注入的压力超过了那个可怜铝瓶能承受的。有一个船员系统，但几乎没什么用处。当然，你可以直接命令他们完全拆解某艘船并把所有东西运回家，或者在主角色睡觉时用第二个船员作为你的角色，但你必须付钱给他们，而且如果他们不戴头盔走出气闸，你还要付死亡费用，而不知为何他们这么做的频率比我想要的更高……是的，有办法购买公民身份并获得你自己的公寓，但你只能买同一个，他们还没有添加更多。再次强调，这将在未来添加，他们已经确认了，这更像是一个“现在就买”的缺点。
- 某些东西缺乏多样性。
只有3个食品品牌，便宜得要命的保存食品大约有10种口味变化，还有两个街头小贩，每人提供3道菜。工具很少——螺丝刀、钢锯、它们更好的版本角磨机和电钻、小型焊机、焊接工具以及它们更好的替代品激光工具。还有撬棍。真的可以多用几个品牌/工具变体，比如电钻有不同的品牌，哪怕只有2到3个也好。相比其他一些事情，这不算太关键，比如，游戏里有一个非法站点，里面有“毒品贩子”，但除了4种药片（医疗）、3种注射剂（医疗）之外基本上就没有毒品了，差不多就这些。

items.text:
tldr; I love everything this game is trying to do - I just wish what was there actually worked with a greater degree of regularity. But, we're in Early Access, and there are a lot of systems to work on here. When this game reaches 1.0, it will undoubtedly be something quite special.

The beginning: You start as a nobody, going through a really unique character creation/aging phase reminiscent of a classic text adventure where you build your backstory, navigating conflicts, learning about the world, earning experience and other things along the way, and once you're ready, you're dropped into whatever starting vessel you were lucky enough to get your hands on. This could be a capable yet busted up freighter, or it could be the equivalent of a rocket powered refrigerator.

From there, you're on your own, and this is where the struggle begins. There are a lot of systems here - this is a good thing, and that systemic depth is reinforced by solid (so far) world building, some surprisingly lovely art, and a real feeling of being a free agent in a world much, much larger than you that doesn't even know you exist - yet. You are a tiny speck in the vastness of space, and you need to take care of that speck - oxygen, food, drink, and whatever else you happen to be addicted to. You'll tend to your wants, needs, and vices, and figure out what kind of life you'd like to lead.

By this point, you probably have some small goals in mind - you want to play dress up a little, you want to fiddle with ship systems, you want to meet new people, or maybe you want to work on your ship for a bit, or... perhaps you're a bloodthirsty pirate and desire a quick, violent upgrade to both your wallet and your vessel of choice. You can do all of these things, and again, on paper, this sounds like an excellent time - and it CAN be - until it isn't.

I've had bugs with repeating, inescapable dialog. I've had bugs with the atmospheric system suddenly making the air in my suit or ship completely vanish. I've had bugs with the crime system, being arrested for (what appeared to be) no reason. Bugs, bugs, bugs. But, again, we're in Early Access, and now that Kitfox is publishing (yay!), hopefully this speeds things along in the right direction.

The bottom line:
I do not recommend buying this game IF you're expecting a polished, stable experience. There are many systems at play here, and it is quite clear that at this stage, they need a good amount of work. Updates seem to be rolling in slowly, too, though with each update comes a sizeable amount of fixes and content.

However, if you see this game and it *resonates* with you, and you're fully aware of what it entails and what state it's in, I'd say pick it up, give it a shot, and you'll likely see a glimmer of something very, very cool. I'm looking forward to 1.0.
items.text_zh:
长话短说；我喜欢这款游戏试图做的一切——我只是希望现有的内容能更稳定地正常运作。不过，我们还在抢先体验阶段，这里有很多系统需要完善。当这款游戏达到1.0版本时，它无疑会是一款相当特别的作品。

开端：你从一个无名小卒开始，经历一个非常独特的角色创建/成长阶段，让人想起经典的文字冒险游戏，你在其中构建自己的背景故事，应对冲突，了解这个世界，一路获得经验和其他东西，一旦你准备好了，就会被丢进你幸运获得的任何起始飞船里。这可能是一艘性能不错但破破烂烂的货船，也可能相当于一台火箭动力的冰箱。

从那时起，你就得靠自己了，而挣扎也由此开始。这里有大量的系统——这是好事，而这种系统性的深度又得到了扎实的（目前为止）世界观构建、一些出奇可爱的美术，以及一种真实的感觉所支撑：你是一个自由行动者，身处一个比你大得多、甚至还不知道你存在的世界——暂时还不知道。你是浩瀚太空中一粒微小的尘埃，而你需要照顾好这粒尘埃——氧气、食物、饮水，以及任何你碰巧上瘾的东西。你会照料自己的欲望、需求和恶习，并弄清楚自己想过什么样的生活。

到这个时候，你心里可能已经有了一些小目标——你想稍微打扮一下，你想摆弄飞船系统，你想结识新朋友，或者也许你想花点时间捣鼓自己的飞船，又或者……你是个嗜血的海盗，想要快速、暴力地升级你的钱包和你选中的飞船。这些事你都能做，而且再说一次，纸面上看，这听起来像是一段绝佳的时光——它确实可以是这样——直到它不再是。

我遇到过重复、无法逃脱的对话bug。我遇到过大气系统突然让我宇航服或飞船里的空气完全消失的bug。我遇到过犯罪系统的bug，莫名其妙（看起来是这样）就被逮捕了。Bug，bug，bug。不过，再说一次，我们还在抢先体验阶段，而且既然Kitfox现在负责发行（耶！），希望这能推动事情朝着正确的方向加速前进。

底线：
如果你期待的是打磨完善、稳定可靠的体验，我不推荐购买这款游戏。这里涉及许多系统，而且很明显，在这个阶段，它们还需要大量的完善。更新似乎也来得很慢，不过每次更新都会带来相当数量的修复和内容。

然而，如果你看到这款游戏，而且它*引起你的共鸣*，并且你完全清楚它包含什么、处于什么状态，我会说买下它，试一试，你很可能会看到某种非常非常酷的东西的微光。我很期待1.0。

items.text:
I've been playing this game since .13, and I have to say, it has gotten so very, very good. I'm about 150 hours into my first 1.0 game and I still probably have another hundred hours of content ahead of me if I wanted to 100% it. This is one of my favorite games now. If you're considering a purchase, be aware of 2 things: You will encounter some bugs, and it is intentionally clunky. I think people might start this game and not be aware of that the clunk is intentional to give the game the right vibes. They have improved the quality of life substantially though, including a well polished tutorial.

The current state of the game is enough to give a new player 200 hours of play time, with several accomplishments you'll be making on the way. Some of these accomplishments feel major, like putting your first reactor together or paying off your mortgage. I realize that sounds lame but it's actually incredibly satisfying to pay off an imaginary mortgage. If you like to horde stuff, build your ship, or scavenge, this is absolutely a game you'll like. That being said, you'll die a lot. You can always reload a save, but until you get a grasp of everything you'll die in many interesting ways. The game has a large learning curve, but it is an entertaining learning curve. Part of the experience is figuring it out through trial and error. You don't really need to look stuff up either, it teaches you with resources provided in-game, like the fusion manual or data on something you loot. 

Also, while there have been some pretty severe bugs in the past, the serious ones are gone. Generally, you'll only encounter minor bugs or bugs that are fixed with a reload. Some parts of this game may also feel like a bug, but they often are not. For instance, when doing long range travel the first time, you might crash into Venus. That's not a bug, you set a course that goes through Venus. Once you know what you're doing, that could have been avoided by choosing your arrival time better.

I absolutely recommend this game. It currently has tons of content, despite having several areas that aren't completely finished. Every station seems to have some content, but I do believe they'll be adding new fun mechanics in some of the stations lacking content. I can't wait until every area is finished.
items.text_zh:
我从0.13版本就开始玩这款游戏了，不得不说，它变得非常非常出色。我的第一个1.0存档已经玩了大约150个小时，如果我想100%完成的话，前面可能还有一百个小时的内容等着我。现在这是我最喜欢的游戏之一。如果你正在考虑购买，请注意两件事：你会遇到一些bug，而且游戏是故意做得有些笨拙的。我觉得人们刚开始玩这款游戏时可能没有意识到，这种笨拙是故意为之，是为了给游戏营造正确的氛围。不过他们已经大幅改善了游戏体验，包括一个打磨得很好的教程。

游戏目前的状态足以给新玩家提供200小时的游玩时间，一路上你还会完成几项成就。其中一些成就感觉很重要，比如组装你的第一座反应堆或者还清你的房贷。我知道这听起来很逊，但还清一笔虚构的房贷实际上令人无比满足。如果你喜欢囤积东西、建造自己的飞船或者拾荒，这绝对是一款你会喜欢的游戏。话虽如此，你会死很多次。你随时可以重新读取存档，但在你掌握一切之前，你会以许多有趣的方式死去。这款游戏的学习曲线很陡，但这是一条充满乐趣的学习曲线。体验的一部分就是通过反复试验来摸索明白。你其实也不需要去查攻略，它会用游戏内提供的资源来教你，比如聚变手册或者你拾取物品上的数据。

另外，虽然过去曾有一些相当严重的bug，但那些严重的问题已经没有了。一般来说，你只会遇到一些小bug，或者重新读取存档就能修复的bug。这款游戏的某些部分可能也会让你觉得像bug，但往往并不是。例如，第一次进行远距离旅行时，你可能会撞上金星。那不是bug，是你设定的航线穿过了金星。一旦你知道自己在做什么，本可以通过更好地选择抵达时间来避免这种情况。

我绝对推荐这款游戏。它目前有大量的内容，尽管还有几个区域没有完全完成。每个空间站似乎都有一些内容，但我相信他们会在一些缺乏内容的空间站中加入新的有趣机制。我迫不及待地想让每个区域都完成。

observations.description: 仍会遇到一些轻微bug，通常重载可解决
observations.evidence: Generally, you'll only encounter minor bugs or bugs that are fixed with a reload.
observations.evidence_zh: 一般来说，你只会遇到一些小bug，或者重新加载就能修复的bug。

items.text:
It's a great RPG with procedural and environmental storytelling. The tutorial teaches you how to fly the ship in less then 10 minutes, given you know what delta-v and such terms mean. The real challenges come from the space environment and the world itself which is really great.

For example, if you only have an oxygen pump on board and step through your airlock into space, some of your atmosphere will escape and be replaced by oxygen alone. Meaning that while it was safe to smoke a cigarette at first, it won't be after a while.

The world itself has a very good lore and it's own rules which you can follow or not. For example, you will see those posters regarding work safety, stating that every workplace has to have one of these visibly displayed. If you don't have one of them on your ship (because you never read one and therefore didn't know about this rule) and you get an inspection, you will have to pay a fine (or find another way of dealing with corporate pigs). 

I once found a friend (created during an event in character creation) dead on a derelict spaceship, next to a corporate police officer (also dead) and something akin to the movie 'The Thing'. The ship itself, it's atmospheric composition and the files I obtained after hacking both their 'phones' drew a very clear picture of what happened which made me feel like that inspector guy from 'The Expanse'.

There is a very unique dialogue system in place as well, where you have to balance your needs for, let's say privacy and personal ambition while the opposing person is doing that as well. I think it's termed 'social combat' which seems like a very good description.

Read in another review that flights are boring and there's nothing to do which I really don't understand. Since you are moving at the same speed as your ship you can just walk outside and expand on it. 
Or stay inside and do maintenance. 
Or read one of the manuals if you bought them.
Or attend your personal needs, like getting drunk and smoking weed. 
Or most importantly organize your equipment so that you can be really efficient on your next disembark - since everything from water and food, electric power and the air you breath (in essence time) are valuable and have to be managed.

Yes, you might have to restart the game once or twice because you didn't know something and locked yourself into an impossible position but that's part of the learning experience and part of the fun. But it's not a hard or difficult game and you don't need to watch any tutorials for the experience of being a self sufficient belter, proud owner of a flying peace of junk.

Highly recommended if you don't mind the graphics and a few bugs. Looking forward to the next big update to bring long range travel.
items.text_zh:
这是一款出色的RPG，拥有程序化生成和环境叙事。教程会在不到10分钟内教会你如何驾驶飞船，前提是你知道delta-v之类的术语是什么意思。真正的挑战来自太空环境和世界本身，而这真的非常棒。

例如，如果你船上只有一个氧气泵，然后穿过气闸进入太空，你的一部分大气会逸出，并被纯氧取代。这意味着虽然一开始抽烟是安全的，但过一会儿就不安全了。

世界本身有非常好的背景设定和自己的规则，你可以遵守也可以不遵守。例如，你会看到那些关于工作安全的海报，上面写着每个工作场所都必须显眼地展示其中一张。如果你的船上没有其中一张（因为你从未读过，因此不知道这条规则），并且你接受了检查，你就必须支付罚款（或者找另一种方式对付那些企业猪猡）。

我曾经发现一个朋友（在角色创建期间的一次事件中创建的）死在一艘废弃飞船上，旁边是一名企业警察（也死了），还有某种类似电影《怪形》的东西。那艘飞船本身、它的大气成分，以及我黑入他们两人的“手机”后获得的文件，描绘出了一幅非常清晰的画面，让我感觉自己就像《苍穹浩瀚》里的那个督察。

游戏里还有一个非常独特的对话系统，你必须在比如隐私和个人野心等需求之间取得平衡，而对方也在做同样的事。我想这被称为“社交战斗”，这似乎是一个非常贴切的描述。

在另一篇评测里读到说飞行很无聊，无事可做，我真的不理解。因为你和飞船以相同速度移动，你可以直接走到外面并扩建它。
或者待在内部做维护。
或者读一本你买来的手册。
或者满足你的个人需求，比如喝醉和抽大麻。
或者最重要的是整理你的装备，这样你下次下船时就能真正高效——因为从水和食物、电力到你呼吸的空气（本质上是时间）的一切都很宝贵，都必须加以管理。

是的，你可能不得不重启游戏一两次，因为你不知道某件事，把自己锁进了一个不可能的局面，但这是学习体验的一部分，也是乐趣的一部分。但这不是一款硬核或困难的游戏，你不需要为了体验成为一个自给自足的带环小行星带人、一艘飞行垃圾的骄傲拥有者而看任何教程。

如果你不介意画面和一些bug，强烈推荐。期待下一个大型更新带来远程旅行。

observations.evidence: Highly recommended if you don't mind the graphics and a few bugs.
observations.evidence_zh: 如果你不介意画面和几个bug，强烈推荐。

items.text:
Let me prephrase this with the usual Early Access warning - 
This game is in development.
Buy it if you wanna support it in hopefully becoming a great game.
Don't buy it if you expect a full game without any bugs, with full features and smooth GUIs.

This game is a great space sim and potential RPG (not a whole lot there yet besides the beginnings of some plots).

It has a fantastic vibe, you feel like a poor worker starting out with your tin can of a ship to slowly illegally strip down ships for their components and avoid patrols until you get enough money to buy licenses, expand your ship and pay off your mortgage.

For now it has a bunch of different mechanics, some more complete than others, some buggier than others.
- building your char (stats, skills and customisation)
- doing small one-time jobs (deliver stuff, talk to NPCs, explore wrecks)
- a few different plot lines
- survival elements (pay attention to hunger, thirst and most importantly your air and its mixture)
- ingame ship building
- building systems for automated management of the air in your ship (N2, O2, CO2, temperature)
- power management (reactors, batteries, switches, power cables and consumers)
- hiring and managing a crew
- salvaging of derelicts and selling the parts either through legal means or via the black market (if you can find it)
- meaningful interactions with NPCs (satisfy the social needs of your char and/or your crew, lower accrued fines, unlock the black market, get infos/hint for quests, ...
- inventory tetris on multiple levels (in the world, your inventory and the nested inventories of containers, backpacks and crates)
- real-time fighting system with unarmed close quarter, armed close quarter and ranged, with blocking, dodging and movement
- pausing, slowing down or speeding up of ingame time

Tho be warned it has a steep learning curve and while there is a small tutorial and an ingame documentation, there will be a lot of trial and error.
[b]And a pro tip turn up the autosave frequency, the max amount of autosave and get into a habit of regularly saving manually.[/b] There are some events that can be catastrophic for your playthrough and also some unexpected behaviour and bugs.

So if you can ignore the rough edges you can spend a ton of time and have a lot of fun in the game and slowly building up your tin can into a huge multicrew hauler.
items.text_zh:
让我用通常的抢先体验警告来作为开场白——
这款游戏还在开发中。
如果你想支持它，希望它能成为一款伟大的游戏，那就买吧。
如果你期望一款没有任何bug、功能完整、界面流畅的完整游戏，那就别买。

这款游戏是一款出色的太空模拟游戏，也有潜力成为RPG（目前除了几条剧情的开端之外，内容还不太多）。

它有着绝佳的氛围，你感觉自己就像一个穷苦工人，开着自己的破铁皮船起步，慢慢非法拆解飞船获取零件，躲避巡逻，直到攒够钱买许可证、扩建飞船并还清房贷。

目前它有一堆不同的机制，有些比其他的更完整，有些比其他的bug更多。
- 创建你的角色（属性、技能和自定义）
- 做小型一次性工作（送东西、和NPC交谈、探索残骸）
- 几条不同的剧情线
- 生存元素（注意饥饿、口渴，最重要的是你的空气及其混合比例）
- 游戏内飞船建造
- 用于自动管理飞船内空气（N2、O2、CO2、温度）的建造系统
- 电力管理（反应堆、电池、开关、电缆和用电设备）
- 雇佣和管理船员
- 打捞废弃飞船，并通过合法途径或黑市（如果你能找到的话）出售零件
- 与NPC进行有意义的互动（满足你的角色和/或船员的社会需求，降低累积的罚款，解锁黑市，获取任务信息/提示……）
- 多层级的物品栏俄罗斯方块（世界中、你的物品栏，以及容器、背包和板条箱的嵌套物品栏）
- 实时战斗系统，包括徒手近战、持械近战和远程，带有格挡、闪避和移动
- 暂停、减慢或加快游戏内时间

不过要警告你，它的学习曲线很陡峭，虽然有一个小教程和游戏内文档，但还是会有大量的试错。
[b]还有一个专业提示：调高自动保存频率、自动保存的最大数量，并养成定期手动保存的习惯。[/b]有些事件可能会对你的游玩过程造成灾难性影响，还有一些意外行为和bug。

所以，如果你能忽略这些粗糙的边缘，你就能在这款游戏里花上大量时间，享受很多乐趣，并慢慢把你的破铁皮船建成一艘巨大的多船员运输船。

items.text:
*I* love this game. You may not.
It has a very unique art style, and combines Space Station 13, with the Expanse and Hard Space Shipbreaker. 
The visuals can be confusing, the tutorial hints are often vague or entirely absent, it's still very early Access, with some bugs. That being said, it has a decent gameplay loop, pretty good emergent gameplay for being singleplayer, and an interesting, if familiar world. Most of the UI is skeumorphic.
items.text_zh:
*我*喜欢这款游戏。你可能不喜欢。
它有着非常独特的美术风格，把《太空站13》与《苍穹浩瀚》和《硬核飞船拆解师》结合在了一起。
视觉效果可能会让人困惑，教程提示往往含糊不清或完全缺失，它仍然处于非常早期的抢先体验阶段，还有一些bug。话虽如此，它有一个不错的玩法循环，对于单人游戏来说有相当不错的涌现式玩法，还有一个有趣但似曾相识的世界。大部分UI都是拟物化的。

items.text:
I love this game.
I do recommend this game and I have recommended this game to friends and family.
The graphics are tough at first but after a while I am able to distinguish between a bin, vent and a door.
The learning curve is steep but satisfying when you get to the top(don’t worry there are other curves to climb after the first). If it get too difficult then there is a great workshop community ready to offer aid and advice on most topics.
Plus read the books in game and the help file.
I rate this game. It is not for everyone, if you prefer the console era of game play where you are hand held, constantly praised and never die then this game wont be for you, try No Man’s Sky.
It is in early access and yes it does have a few wrinkles to be ironed out, but I’m enjoying the journey.
items.text_zh:
我喜欢这款游戏。
我确实推荐这款游戏，而且我已经向朋友和家人推荐过这款游戏。
画面一开始很难辨认，但过了一段时间后，我能够区分垃圾桶、通风口和门了。
学习曲线很陡峭，但当你爬到顶端时会很有满足感（别担心，爬过第一座山后还有别的山要爬）。如果它变得太难，那么有一个很棒的创意工坊社区随时准备在大多数话题上提供帮助和建议。
另外，读一读游戏内的书籍和帮助文件。
我给这款游戏打分。它并不适合所有人，如果你更喜欢主机时代的游戏玩法，那种有人手把手带你、不断夸你、永远不会死的游戏，那么这款游戏不适合你，去试试《无人深空》吧。
它处于抢先体验阶段，是的，它确实有一些需要抹平的皱纹，但我很享受这段旅程。

observations.description: 游戏处于抢先体验阶段，还有一些小问题需要解决
observations.evidence: It is in early access and yes it does have a few wrinkles to be ironed out
observations.evidence_zh: 它处于抢先体验阶段，是的，确实有一些小问题需要解决

items.text:
At its current stage its super janky, things are broken or missing, the main space station tends to run out of breathable air sooner or later, brain dead ai keeps trying to ram into me, yet it's still stupidly compelling to just head on out into space, find a ship and loot it of all usable parts to make yourself rich. 

Or at least rich enough to afford a toilet for your ship so you can stop pooping yourself in your suit.
items.text_zh:
在目前这个阶段，它超级粗糙，东西要么坏了要么缺失，主空间站迟早会耗尽可呼吸的空气，脑残的AI老是试图撞我，然而它仍然蠢得让人着迷，就是直接飞进太空，找到一艘飞船，把里面所有能用的零件都搜刮一空，让自己发财。

或者至少富到能给你的飞船买得起一个马桶，这样你就不用在自己的宇航服里拉屎了。

observations.evidence: things are broken or missing
observations.evidence_zh: 东西要么坏了，要么缺失

items.text:
Fantastic game if you are looking for something a little slower pace, I love how every wreck is a little different and how satisfying it feels looking at your ship loaded to the brim with salvage. Also has some surprisingly tense moments (like when I had to quickly abandon a derelict I was working on before an NPC ship slammed into us going mach 5, keep your proximity alarm on). 

It is an early access game and some game play mechanics feel pretty clunky such as the combat/social system but it has its own kind of strange charm to it. I also find it doesn't interfere too much with the main game for me. 

There have been some bugs but nothing major or game breaking. (At least in my experience) It's still in development so if bugs really bother you it would be wise to give this a little more time to cook.  

This game doesn't really explain much to you when you are first starting out, but once you are over that learning curve it is a ton of fun.
items.text_zh:
如果你在寻找节奏稍慢一些的东西，这是一款极棒的游戏，我喜欢每一艘残骸都略有不同，以及看着你的飞船装满了打捞物时那种满足感。还有一些出乎意料紧张的时刻（比如当我不得不迅速放弃一艘我正在作业的废弃飞船，因为一艘NPC飞船以5马赫的速度撞上了我们，保持你的接近警报开着）。

这是一款抢先体验游戏，一些游戏机制感觉相当笨拙，比如战斗/社交系统，但它有自己一种奇怪的魅力。我也发现它对我来说不太干扰主游戏。

有一些bug，但都不重大或破坏游戏。（至少在我的体验中）它仍在开发中，所以如果bug真的困扰你，明智的做法是再给它一点时间慢慢炖。

这款游戏在你刚开始时其实没怎么向你解释，但一旦你越过了那条学习曲线，就非常有趣。

observations.evidence: There have been some bugs but nothing major or game breaking.
observations.evidence_zh: 有一些bug，但都不是什么大问题或会破坏游戏体验的。

items.text:
Game has some early access bugs, but is a very good space scrapyard simulator. However i wish the over engineered mood system would be removed. 

It's trying to be the space sims, but looking at your character sleeping for hours on end is not all that fun and managing multiple crew members can be a chore. They are not that smart.

Released to 1.0, but it feels unfinished.

Not recommended

items.text:
Fun space neo scavangers type game.  Can be brutal, but that's part of the fun. There is ship building, some engineering there, decent amount of complexity.  

The game is still in early access and limited to a single station/system with more expected in the roadmap. There are still some bugs, but that is how EA goes.   

I can see this being even better as they complete all their goals.  It's a great ship building game / ship scavaging / ship breaker game that you can sink hours into as is.  

Looking forward to the future.
items.text_zh:
好玩的太空新拾荒者类型游戏。可能很残酷，但这也是乐趣的一部分。有飞船建造，里面有些工程内容，复杂度也相当可观。

游戏仍处于抢先体验阶段，仅限于单个空间站/星系，路线图中预计会有更多内容。还有一些bug，但抢先体验就是这样。

我能看到，等他们完成所有目标后，这游戏会变得更好。这是一款很棒的飞船建造/飞船拾荒/拆船游戏，就目前这样你也能投入好几个小时。

期待未来。

observations.evidence: There are still some bugs
observations.evidence_zh: 仍然还有一些bug

items.text:
The game is still in the early stages, but since the latest updates I started seeing a lot of that same charm the NeoScavenger had. That and the setting is a very fun one, where the deadly environment contrasts nicely as you learn the mechanics, learn to prepare to deal with situations as they happen better. 

At some point you go from a cautious scavenger picking at the edges of the boneyards to being an opportunistic spacer looking for a way to get  ahead of the corporate chokehold you were locked into. And a lot of small things help sell that feeling.

The additions of the lore snippets in data devices and some fun things to encounter in wrecks to make them more risky injects some much needed excitement and thrill into the act of scavenging compared to the earlier builds.

As always with a game in early stages, expect bugs, expect weird behaviors. If that's a problem might recommend waiting a bit, but overall a great game I keep coming back to and the developers are updating at a healthy pace.
items.text_zh:
游戏仍处于早期阶段，但自从最近的更新以来，我开始看到很多与NeoScavenger相同的魅力。而且设定非常有趣，致命的环境形成了很好的对比，因为你学习机制，学会更好地准备应对突发情况。

在某个时刻，你从一个在骨场边缘小心翼翼拾荒的拾荒者，变成了一个机会主义的太空人，寻找方法在你被锁定的企业扼制中取得优势。很多小细节帮助营造了这种感觉。

在数据设备中加入的传说片段，以及在残骸中遇到的一些有趣事物使它们更加危险，为拾荒行为注入了与早期版本相比急需的兴奋和刺激。

与处于早期阶段的游戏一样，预期会有bug，预期会有奇怪的行为。如果这是个问题，可能建议等一等，但总体而言是一款很棒的、我不断回来的游戏，开发者也在以健康的速度更新。

items.text:
Don't let my play time fool you, I have been on and off with this game but I think I have finally given up on it after a mildly enjoyable but equally frustrating playthrough. The triggering incident? A hauler ship hit me at ramming speed for no reason at all while I was working on a derelict ship . There was nothing I could do about it and I died from internal bleeding minutes after. Now you can argue that kind of behaviour can be patched out but this game has issues that goes beyond that. In no particular order:

* Awful graphics: I don't mind simple graphics, I don't mind indie games but when the graphics are so ugly and cluttered that they impede in your understanding of what's going on it becomes a problem. I shouldn't have to read things and click through things to see there is a big hole in the ship yet that's what you have to do in this game. It's difficult to read and recognize items at a glance and what you see doesn't always correspond to game mechanics.
* Awful interface: Now, look I played NEO Scavenger alright. I love that game but it had the most horrific GUI I have ever seen modern video game. This game's GUI is a bit more sophisticated than that but it still suffers from the same problems. You have to click through things multiple times to give simple commands and there is an obtuse choices menu you have to scroll through for everything. Building or uninstalling things are a pain. I often find myself struggling with the game to tell it to do what I want and that's never a good sign.
* Finicky, useless dialog system that suffers from the same interface problems with no immersive qualities and mostly about filling out some bars. Fun!
* Long-standing bugs and issues that doesn't seem to get fixed. Were you uninstalling something mounted to a wall and it had no nearby empty space to drop? Too bad, now it's on the other side of the wall and in space for some reason and it's a huge pain to get it. Did I mention the interface is frustrating?

So on and so forth. The reason why ı stayed with this game for so long is because I really liked No Scavenger and I was on board with the premise, but it seems to have all the flaws of that game except they are compounded even further because of its ambitious scope.
items.text_zh:
别让我的游戏时长骗了你，我断断续续地玩这款游戏，但在经历了一次有点愉快但同样令人沮丧的通关后，我想我终于放弃它了。触发事件？一艘运输船在我修理一艘废弃飞船时，毫无理由地以撞击速度撞向我。我对此无能为力，几分钟后我因内出血而死。现在你可以争辩说这种行为可以通过补丁修复，但这款游戏的问题远不止于此。不分先后：

* 糟糕的画面：我不介意简单的画面，我不介意独立游戏，但当画面如此丑陋和杂乱，以至于妨碍你理解正在发生的事情时，这就成了问题。我不应该为了看到船上有个大洞而不得不阅读东西并点击浏览，但这就是你在这款游戏中必须做的。很难一眼读懂和识别物品，而且你看到的东西并不总是与游戏机制相符。
* 糟糕的界面：听着，我玩过《NEO Scavenger》好吧。我喜欢那款游戏，但它有着我在现代电子游戏中见过的最可怕的图形用户界面。这款游戏的图形用户界面比那个稍微精致一些，但它仍然有同样的问题。你必须多次点击浏览才能给出简单的命令，而且有一个晦涩难懂的选择菜单，你必须为所有事情滚动浏览。建造或卸载东西很痛苦。我经常发现自己与游戏搏斗，想告诉它做我想做的事，这从来都不是好兆头。
* 挑剔、无用的对话系统，有着同样的界面问题，没有沉浸感，主要是填充一些进度条。真有趣！
* 长期存在的错误和问题似乎没有得到修复。你在卸载安装在墙上的东西，而附近没有空位可以掉落？太糟糕了，现在它不知为何到了墙的另一边，在太空中，要拿到它非常痛苦。我提到界面令人沮丧了吗？

诸如此类。我之所以坚持玩这款游戏这么久，是因为我真的很喜欢《No Scavenger》，我也认同它的设定，但它似乎有那款游戏的所有缺陷，只是由于其雄心勃勃的范围而进一步加剧了。

items.text:
Short Version:
I am a fan of Firefly and the expanse to name some similar universes, and this game provides a parallel for sure to them. Replay-ability is very good with the Procedural Generation at Char Creation. Everything about this game is a simulation, done right. It may look like GTA 1 (top down), but every darn Device, Box, Bag, Item, --> builds immersion due to the screens / design / functionality. It does feel like early access, but bugs are constantly being fixed, and the bugs I experience are mostly tiny bugs that I can keep playing with. Tip: if you are really 'vibe-ing' with a character play-though, keep a save at least 1hr or more from the rest of the saves in case you move into some big bug. I list some bugs I have hit below. I recommend this game and I still play it regularly.

Long Version:
Extra Effort.
>The "Help" button on the Main Menu:  The Main Menu is a Ship's Bridge/Computer Terminal and the Help button is a literal manual (or hefty book) sitting on the desk. When clicked, that manual opens, formatted with game info, in a binder, as a tech manual would be. These fine details are very much entirely in this game.

Simulation Done Right.
>Every device menu (of a certain manufacturer) is its own unique screen with wear and tear you would expect from devices in this weathered in environment. There are no shortage of clicky knobs, toggle switches, blinky lights. These very complicated screens are actually very intuitive once you use them successfully.

Speed Up Menial Tasks.
>It has a way to speed up the game (x1, x2, x4, x8, x16), but it also has situational bad things as any sim, so the clock-increase button doesn't feel like god-mode (nor does it make you want to play less as some QoL mechanics in other games do), since speeding up time can cause any bad thing that naturally occurs in a situation to ... occur faster. Cons of speeding up time: (Police traveling your way for a routine Inspection, CO2 Buildup in the cheap Enviro Suit, Ship Power consumption, etc.) Pros of speeding up time: (Repair/Un-/Install Time, Ship travel time, Drill Battery Charge time on the manufacturer specific Battery Charger, recovering health attributes when resting, etc.)

Bugs do happen.  
>I have had one crash in 34 hours (at the time of writing this review) of game-play. 
>When I drop Items the easy way when on other items (not the correct way of - drag them to a specific floor or container location) there is a 1% chance they glitch through the floor or into nothingness (example: once dropping an empty crate onto a crate). Though, those items that I drop that way tend to be junk anyways. 
>Sometimes a bug will be shown in the drop-down dev command line interface, and they will not be directly related to what you are doing. (example: person didn't load)  You then just minimize the drop-down dev command line interface or save, quit, load for security or random peace-of-mind.
>I had a police cruiser waiting to dock with me as I was undocking from a derelict for a routine check. That pilot bumped me, then docked, putting us into a fast moving coast through space... which I didn't realize until I saved over all pre-dock save files, and created a situation where the best save I had was 60 seconds from both of our ship randomly crashing into something in our path (the kind of crash that destroys your ship and your suit).  I was okay with this (normally game-play-crushing event) since a restart meant a new char and new generated universe... that and my char was a very wanted individual which made game-play less desirable at that point. 
>A recent patch had to do with Hauler ships moving derelicts.  I now see hauler ships moving derelicts bumping stations I am docked on repeatedly stopping the time speed-up (due to prox alarm) and constantly triggering prox alarms (if toggled on). This is an obvious dumb driving AI bug or the AI cannot compensate for the load.  It will probably be patched out. It is a nuisance.  My best workaround it going to a diff station from time to time.  This is in my review to give you a good example of early access bugs that can crop up.
>It does help that reloads of the game are very fast since this game is not large from a file standpoint.

I have wanted this kind of sim for a long time and randomly came across it... I need to find a way to input Movies into a list and the output = games that feel similar.

I very much enjoy this game and recommend it.
items.text_zh:
简短版：
我是《萤火虫》和《无垠的太空》等类似宇宙设定的粉丝，而这款游戏确实为它们提供了一个平行世界。角色创建时的程序化生成让重玩性非常好。这款游戏的一切都是一场模拟，而且做得恰到好处。它看起来可能像《侠盗猎车手1》（俯视视角），但每一个该死的设备、箱子、袋子、物品——>都通过屏幕/设计/功能营造出沉浸感。它确实感觉像是抢先体验版，但bug在不断被修复，而我遇到的bug大多是些小bug，不影响我继续玩。提示：如果你真的对某个角色的游玩流程很“有感觉”，那就留一个与其他存档至少相隔1小时或更久的存档，以防你遇到什么大bug。我在下面列出了一些我遇到过的bug。我推荐这款游戏，而且我仍然经常玩它。

长版：
额外的用心。
>主菜单上的“帮助”按钮：主菜单是一个飞船舰桥/计算机终端，而帮助按钮就是放在桌上的一本实实在在的手册（或者说厚书）。点击后，那本手册会打开，里面以游戏信息排版，放在活页夹里，就像一本技术手册那样。这些精细的细节在这款游戏里比比皆是。

模拟做得恰到好处。
>每个设备菜单（来自某个特定制造商）都是它自己独特的屏幕，带有你会在这个饱经风霜的环境中从设备上预期到的磨损痕迹。可点击的旋钮、拨动开关、闪烁的指示灯应有尽有。这些非常复杂的屏幕一旦你成功使用过，实际上会变得非常直观。

加速琐碎任务。
>它有一种加速游戏的方法（x1、x2、x4、x8、x16），但它也像任何模拟游戏一样有情境性的坏事，所以加速时钟的按钮不会让人觉得像开了上帝模式（也不会像其他游戏里某些生活质量机制那样让你不想玩），因为加速时间会导致任何在某种情境下自然发生的坏事……发生得更快。加速时间的缺点：（警察为例行检查朝你赶来、廉价环保服中二氧化碳积聚、飞船电力消耗等。）加速时间的优点：（修理/卸载/安装时间、飞船旅行时间、制造商特定电池充电器上的钻头电池充电时间、休息时恢复健康属性等。）

bug确实会发生。
>在34小时（写这篇评测时）的游戏时间里，我遇到过一次崩溃。
>当我在其他物品上以简单方式丢弃物品时（不是正确的方式——把它们拖到特定的地板或容器位置），有1%的几率它们会穿模掉进地板或虚无之中（例如：有一次把一个空板条箱丢到一个板条箱上）。不过，我以那种方式丢弃的物品往往都是垃圾。
>有时bug会显示在下拉式开发者命令行界面中，而且它们不会与你正在做的事情直接相关。（例如：人物没有加载）然后你只需最小化下拉式开发者命令行界面，或者为了安全或随机求个心安而保存、退出、加载。
>我曾遇到一艘警用巡逻艇在我从一艘废弃飞船解缆离开时等着与我对接，进行例行检查。那个飞行员撞了我一下，然后对接了，把我们带入了一段高速漂移穿越太空的状态……直到我覆盖了所有对接前的存档文件后我才意识到这一点，并造成了一种情况：我最好的存档距离我们两艘飞船随机撞上路径上的某个东西（那种会摧毁你的飞船和你的宇航服的撞击）只剩60秒。我对这件事倒还接受（这通常是会毁掉游戏进程的事件），因为重新开始意味着一个新角色和一个新生成的宇宙……而且我的角色还是个被高度通缉的人物，这让那时的游戏体验没那么令人向往。

我渴望这种模拟游戏已经很久了，然后偶然遇到了它……我需要找到一种方法，把电影输入到一个列表里，然后输出=感觉相似的电子游戏。

我非常喜欢这款游戏，并推荐它。

items.text:
I like what I see. Solid space survival mechanics, interesting setting, art direction top notch. It's got plenty of components and a solid inventory system. Not only does it have ways to physical your way out of situations, but it has charisma based. 
My first game I found myself terrified by my debt. 
The second game I crashed into some invisible thing I could not see on the nav console and lost 5 hours. (Edit: I now realize that the green circle that OLEG orbits about is actually the bounds of an asteroid. So I flew 500m/s into the surface of a rock)

One note, the common inventory actions don't have specific hotkeys, so doing basic actions involve a lot of clicking. Combat is turn based and a little difficult to figure out.
Third game I got jumped by a pirate and got knocked out. However the pirate just decided to stand above me and write home to family over and over again. I waited for 10 minutes on 16x speed to see if anything would happen or if I would wake up. Nothing happened and so I just restarted.

I also encountered a bug where an item would end up on the floor without a parent. This meant it was essentially stuck there forever. This happened when swapping a single-tile item with a multi-tile item that was on the floor. Depending on where you are standing in the room, you will not be able to put the multi-tile item back and you cannot walk to a place with space. If you press esc, either the item disappears or ends up stuck on the floor homeless.

Its early access so the bugginess is expected. I will be looking forward to updates.
items.text_zh:
我喜欢我所看到的。扎实的太空生存机制，有趣的设定，顶尖的艺术指导。它有很多组件和一个扎实的库存系统。它不仅有用身体摆脱困境的方法，还有基于魅力的方式。
我的第一局游戏里，我被自己的债务吓坏了。
第二局游戏里，我撞上了一些我在导航控制台上看不见的隐形东西，损失了5个小时。（编辑：我现在意识到OLEG环绕的那个绿色圆圈实际上是一颗小行星的边界。所以我以500米/秒的速度飞进了一块岩石的表面）

有一点要注意，常见的库存操作没有特定的快捷键，所以做基本操作需要大量点击。战斗是回合制的，而且有点难以理解。
第三局游戏里，我被一个海盗偷袭并被打晕了。然而那个海盗只是决定站在我上方，一遍又一遍地给家里写信。我以16倍速等了10分钟，看看会不会发生什么，或者我会不会醒来。什么都没发生，所以我只好重新开始。

我还遇到了一个bug，一个物品会掉到地板上而没有父级。这意味着它基本上永远卡在那里了。这发生在我把一个单格物品和一个在地板上的多格物品交换时。根据你在房间里站的位置，你将无法把多格物品放回去，也无法走到有空间的地方。如果你按esc，要么物品消失，要么最终无家可归地卡在地板上。

这是抢先体验版，所以有bug是意料之中的。我会期待更新。

items.text:
Update 15/02/25 (American: 02/15/25):
Since this review, some of these issues have been addressed, while others still remain.

Improvements:
- Crew AI is a little more flexible than it used to be, with some basic priorities for task categories. Crew are more useful than goldfish now, but you will still need to babysit them a little
- NPCs no longer suffocate themselves (mostly)
- Crashes are much more uncommon (although not rare)
- A much more living world. Long-distance travel (and reasons to do so) has since been added, and it's quite satisfying.
- It's down from 80% of time spent fighting bugs to nearly 0%, even in the current test build. Although 65% is still spent fighting design mechanics.

Persistent issues:
- Performance. It's playable on most PCs, but it really chugs. Loading times between zones break immersion frequently
- Inventory management. With a little finesse, you can get a working system set up for salvaging, but you'll always be doing it on the game's terms, not your own. Get ready for a lot of micromanagement.
- AI intelligence. Crew will fetch items one by one, with little concern for efficiency. They follow a very simple series of instructions, in the order you give them, so you'll need to spend about 5 hours learning how to trick them into working the way you want them to and doing the bulk of the menial tasks manually. This is probably the area most ripe for improvement.

Overall, bugs are being crushed, content is expanding (albeit slightly), and core mechanic choices remain a persistent thorn in an otherwise singular game.

It's still a not-recommend for me in its current state, but development progression is promising, so keep an eye on this. Give it another year; it's still heading for an easy recommend.

-------------------

It's a great deal of fun. The fundamental game loop is enjoyable, and the community is quite active (albeit only on discord and not on Steam, which is kind of sus). Plus the developer is reasonably renowned (neo scavenger was excellent, although relatively more barren in content than its system is innovative. I'm hoping Ostranauts won't reach a similar apex).

Once it's in a proper Beta state, this will be an EASY recommend.

However, in its current state, it's exceptionally clunky, buggy, and unrefined.
- Crew AI doesn't offer much yet. They're not much more than liabilities at the moment. But it's more enjoyable if you imagine them as pet goldfish.
- NPCs have a great range of needs, which is nice, but it's more than their current AI is able to respond to. NPCs will suffocate themselves in their own suit; stand at the airlock trying to get to a TV on the station (which you've disallowed them from entering) instead of going to your very nice rec room; and are generally very confused about what they can and can't do.
- Task and hauling management is unreliable and inefficient, it's faster to do everything manually. You can set zones for items, but the UI options are highly limited and auto-hauling seems to exist (because I find items randomly moved around the ship), but I have no idea by what logic. You'll need to manually select items to be hauled and hope you've set up your zones to be close enough to what you want. You can set construction orders and set your crew to automatically build it, but: they will collect items one by one as they build them. And good luck trying to get a crew to handle tasks collaboratively: more often than not, they just make it harder for each other to get anything done.
- And the usual list of bugs you'd expect from a complex game in Alpha, causing you to resort to debug menus, off-and-on, and loading earlier saves.

Overall, it has fantastic potential. It should be in your wishlist and follow list, and ranked amongst the top of them.
Devs are focusing on feature development more than stability, so it's a fun time if (like me), you don't mind working through a bunch of jank to play with some cool toys.

If you want to enjoy the experience, check back in a year. This is a classic early-access title.
If you're willing and able to spend 80% of your game time fighting against bugs and clunky mechanics, come and join!

更新于 15/02/25（美式：02/15/25）：
自这篇评测以来，其中一些问题已经得到解决，而另一些仍然存在。

改进：
- 船员 AI 比以前稍微灵活了一些，对任务类别有一些基本的优先级。船员现在比金鱼更有用，但你仍然需要稍微照看他们
- NPC 不再让自己窒息了（大多数情况下）
- 崩溃变得少见多了（尽管并不罕见）
- 一个更加鲜活的世界。远距离旅行（以及这样做的理由）此后已被加入，而且相当令人满意。
- 从花 80% 的时间与 bug 搏斗降到几乎 0%，即使在当前的测试版本中也是如此。不过仍有 65% 的时间花在与设计机制搏斗上。

持续存在的问题：
- 性能。它在大多数 PC 上都能玩，但确实很卡。区域之间的加载时间经常破坏沉浸感
- 物品栏管理。稍加技巧，你就能为打捞建立一个可用的系统，但你始终是在按游戏的规则行事，而不是你自己的。准备好面对大量的微观管理吧。
- AI 智能。船员会一件一件地取物品，几乎不考虑效率。他们遵循一系列非常简单的指令，按你给出的顺序执行，所以你需要花大约 5 个小时学习如何诱使他们按你想要的方式工作，并手动完成大部分琐碎任务。这大概是最有待改进的领域。

总体而言，bug 正在被消灭，内容正在扩展（尽管幅度不大），而核心机制的选择仍然是一根持续存在的刺，扎在这款在其他方面独一无二的游戏里。

就目前的状态而言，对我来说仍然是不推荐，但开发进展很有希望，所以请继续关注这款游戏。再给它一年时间；它仍然有望轻松获得推荐。

-------------------

它非常有趣。基本的游戏循环令人愉快，社区也相当活跃（尽管只在 Discord 上而不在 Steam 上，这有点可疑）。此外，开发者相当有名（《新拾荒者》非常出色，尽管其内容相对而言比其系统的创新性更为贫瘠。我希望《Ostranauts》不会达到类似的顶峰）。

一旦它进入正式的 Beta 状态，这将是一款轻松推荐的作品。

然而，在目前的状态下，它异常笨拙、bug 多且未经打磨。
- 船员 AI 目前还提供不了太多东西。此刻他们不过是负担而已。但如果你把他们想象成宠物金鱼，就会更有趣一些。
- NPC 有种类繁多的需求，这很好，但这超出了他们当前 AI 所能应对的范围。NPC 会在自己的宇航服里把自己闷死；站在气闸处试图去够空间站上的一台电视（而你已经禁止他们进入那里），而不是去你非常漂亮的娱乐室；而且总体上非常搞不清自己能做什么、不能做什么。
- 任务和搬运管理不可靠且低效，手动做所有事情反而更快。你可以为物品设置区域，但 UI 选项极其有限，而且自动搬运似乎存在（因为我发现物品在飞船里被随机移动），但我完全不知道它是按什么逻辑运作的。你需要手动选择要搬运的物品，并祈祷你设置的区域足够接近你想要的效果。你可以设置建造订单并让船员自动建造，但是：他们在建造时会一件一件地收集物品。而且，祝你好运，试着让船员协作处理任务：大多数情况下，他们只会让彼此更难完成任何事情。
- 还有你在 Alpha 阶段的复杂游戏中会预料到的那一长串常见 bug，迫使你时不时地求助于调试菜单，并反复加载较早的存档。

总体而言，它有着极佳的潜力。它应该在你的愿望单和关注列表里，并且排在其中的前列。
开发者更专注于功能开发而非稳定性，所以如果你（像我一样）不介意克服一堆毛病来玩一些很酷的东西，那会是一段有趣的时光。

如果你想享受这段体验，请一年后再回来看看。这是一款典型的抢先体验作品。
如果你愿意并且能够把 80% 的游戏时间花在与 bug 和笨拙机制搏斗上，那就来加入吧！
任何事情都做完了。

开发者更注重功能开发而非稳定性，所以如果你（像我一样）不介意克服一堆粗糙之处来玩一些很酷的东西，那会是一段有趣的时光。

items.text:
Okay. So the idea of this game is beautiful.

But in practice the game is very buggy. Ontop of that extremely hard learning curve and for those searching for instant gratification if any gratification even... This game is not for you.

I have made probably more then 30 characters before actually even learning the basics, from suffocation to extreme debt, even mulled to death by pirates.

The idea of Neoscavengers combat and inventory is very present, but in a different point of view.

I wanna like this game. I find myself forcing myself to play and understand it all in some futile hope to enjoy this game. Somehow I see a part of myself liking it, but I always get to a point that ruins the whole experience through buggy nonsense 9/10 times, actually 10/10 times. You will eventually understand a game plan through killing yourself more then a dozen times. Again very Neoscavenger idea based. But Neoscavenger was perfect for that idea of playstyle. This doesn't feel right though. This feels painful. no matter how much you want to enjoy this game you simply will leave empty handed.

I honestly want to see this game be good, I am sure some of you will even enjoy the game with enough patience. But truthfully most of you won't until bug fixes have been made. Alot of bug fixes.

I also think the game could benefit from a much more narrow introduction? No actually I have no idea how to tackle a tutorial for this game without disturbing the idea of open world sorta freedom vibe it has going on. Which I do think is nice and I enjoy truly, but for someone like myself who had to watch other people on youtube for multiple hours to simply grasp how to place a floor and then in the process !!accidentally!! learn about zones, a tutorial seems sorta mandatory for this game.

But to be clear I like this game. It does make me grit my teeth with the sheer force of will I am required to put into wanting to enjoy it. But I like it. It just needs some love.
items.text_zh:
好吧。所以这个游戏的理念很美。

但实际上，这游戏bug非常多。除此之外，学习曲线极其陡峭，而对于那些追求即时满足、甚至哪怕只是任何一点满足感的人来说……这游戏不适合你。

在我真正学会基础操作之前，我大概已经创建了30多个角色，从窒息而死到背负巨额债务，甚至被海盗磨死。

Neoscavenger式的战斗和物品栏理念非常明显，只是从不同的视角呈现。

我想喜欢这个游戏。我发现自己强迫自己去玩、去理解这一切，抱着某种徒劳的希望，想享受这个游戏。不知怎的，我能看到自己有一部分喜欢它，但我总是会走到某个点，然后十有八九、实际上是十次十次，都被一堆bug般的胡闹毁掉整个体验。你最终会通过把自己弄死十几次来理解一套游戏思路。这又是非常Neoscavenger式的理念。但Neoscavenger对那种玩法理念来说是完美的。这个感觉却不对劲。这感觉痛苦。无论你多想享受这个游戏，你最终只会空手而归。

我真心希望看到这个游戏变好，我相信你们中有些人只要有足够耐心，甚至会喜欢这个游戏。但说实话，在bug修复完成之前，你们大多数人不会。大量的bug修复。

我还觉得这游戏可以从一个更窄的引导中受益？不，其实我完全不知道该怎么给这游戏做教程，又不破坏它那种开放世界式自由氛围的理念。我确实觉得那种氛围很好，也真心喜欢，但对于像我这样不得不在YouTube上看别人好几个小时，才勉强搞懂怎么放一块地板，然后在这个过程中！！不小心！！了解到区域机制的人来说，教程对这游戏似乎算是必需的。

但说清楚，我喜欢这个游戏。它确实让我咬紧牙关，因为我为了想享受它而不得不投入纯粹的意志力。但我喜欢它。它只是需要一些爱。

Версия 0.14.что-то что-то (последняя бета)

Багов стало меньше, их НЕ МАЛО, но меньше.
Пройдемся по БАЗЕ:
1. Система команды все так же сосет. Брать себе кента - как родить второго ребенка. Если сначала тебе нужно было МИКРОМЕНЕДЖИТЬ целого персонажа, теперь тебе надо делать дополнительные 40 кликов каждый раз когда тебе нужно что-то сделать. Вместе с тем, что приказы работают НЕВЕРОЯТНО КРИВО и большую часть времени перс будет стоять смотреть в пол, потому-что он отказывается верить что запчасть существует только потому-что она за дверью это классика. Все это формирует гигадрочь, серьезно, у вас руки устанут. А теперь представьте - вам надо играть так минимум 8 часов просто чтобы покинуть стартовую локацию. Иными словами, нужно 8 часов заниматься невероятно большим количеством менеджмента карманов, кукл(персов), места, 12 показателями хотбара для каждого персонажа, оплатой, бумажками используя ужасно дырявый инструментарий для геймплея - ТОЛЬКО ЧТОБЫ ПОТРОГАТЬ ИГРУ ВНЕ СТАРТОВОЙ ЛОКИ, БУКВАЛЬНО ПОЕХАТЬ КРЫШЕЙ НАДО ЧТОБЫ ДОБРАТЬСЯ ДО КОНТЕНТА.


18/09/25
v0.14.5.5
Радует что хотя-бы не заброшенный проект.
Многие проблемы описанные выше все еще актуальны.
По фактам:
-Добавили QOL фичи, меньше ебки с инвентарем, стало удобнее перемещать вещи.
-Очень понравилась новая фича с картриджами для ПДА которая открывает новые инструменты и сканеры. Очень полезная штука. (НО!!!! Это наверное лучший способ заработка в начале - искать корабли с жмурами, снимать ПДА и продавать из них файлы и картриджи.)
- Диалоги стали НЕМНОГО приятнее в пользовании.
-Очень хороший игровой гайдбук, приятный на вид, смешной по тексту.
- До контента все так же трудно хоть как-то добраться. Потратив 6 часов в новой версии, все что я опять же смог ощутить это однобразный гринд. Игра позиционирует себя как песочница, но МАКСИМАЛЬНО отказывается ей быть - свобода действий только на словах, ВСЕ упирается в то, что нужно как придурок резать реакторы и надеяться что их скупает барыга. 

Отсюда мои главные притензии и проблемы на данный момент:
- Почему нет опций для начала в других сценариях? Почему нельзя выбрать начальную систему?
- Где хоть какие-то альтернативные пути развития и геймплея, если игра песочница?
-Почему разраб делает те же ошибки в принятии геймплейных решений, что и в Neo Scavanger, после всех слов критики от сообщества?
- Когда игра получит хоть какой-то сюжет, интересные диалоги, запоминающихся персонажей? ДА BLYAT ШАРМА ИГРЕ НЕ ХВАТАЕТ. ЭТО СИМУЛЯТОР КОТОРЫЙ НЕ ХОЧЕТ ЧТОБЫ ИМ ПОЛЬЗОВАЛИСЬ ХОТЬ КАК-ТО КРОМЕ САМОГО СКУЧНОГО, ОДНООБРАЗНОГО И БЛЕКЛОГО СПОСОБА.

Пока что вывод такой - это не игра, это тупо симулятор, причем среднего качества. Пока разраб не выпьет глицинчика и не переосознает, что то, что он делает не побуждает с этим взаимодействовать. Люди напилили кучу модов, которые в разы лучше и осознаннее чем то, что выдает разраб. Только на них и держится хоть какая-то поддержка игры. Боюсь, она станет очередным инди долгостроем, где разрабы не слышат свое же коммьюнити, но упорно тратят свое время и ресурсы поддержавших их игроков, но то, что им и не нужно. Увы

目前还不值得买。
